  1575→// getCondensedFilesTouched reads the files_touched list from the last condensed
  1576→// checkpoint metadata on entire/checkpoints/v1. Used to check staged-file overlap
  1577→// after FilesTouched has been reset by condensation.
  1578→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getCondensedFilesTouched(repo *git.Repository, cpID id.CheckpointID) []string {
  1579→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1580→	summary, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), cpID)
  1581→	if err != nil || summary == nil {
  1582→		return nil
  1583→	}
  1584→	return summary.FilesTouched
  1585→}
  1586→
  1587→// hasOverlappingFiles checks if any file in stagedFiles appears in filesTouched.
  1588→func hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, filesTouched []string) bool {
  1589→	touchedSet := make(map[string]bool)
  1590→	for _, f := range filesTouched {
  1591→		touchedSet[f] = true
  1592→	}
  1593→
  1594→	for _, staged := range stagedFiles {
  1595→		if touchedSet[staged] {
  1596→			return true
  1597→		}
  1598→	}
  1599→	return false
  1600→}

   151→// NormalizeAfterLoad applies backward-compatible migrations to state loaded from disk.
   152→// Call this after deserializing a State from JSON.
   153→func (s *State) NormalizeAfterLoad() {
   154→	// Migrate transcript fields: CheckpointTranscriptStart replaces both
   155→	// CondensedTranscriptLines and TranscriptLinesAtStart from older state files.
   156→	if s.CheckpointTranscriptStart == 0 {
   157→		if s.CondensedTranscriptLines > 0 {
   158→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.CondensedTranscriptLines
   159→		} else if s.TranscriptLinesAtStart > 0 {
   160→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.TranscriptLinesAtStart
   161→		}
   162→	}
   163→	// Clear deprecated fields so they aren't re-persisted.
   164→	// Note: this is a one-way migration. If the state is re-saved, older CLI versions
   165→	// will see 0 for these fields and fall back to scoping from the transcript start.
   166→	// This is acceptable since CLI upgrades are monotonic and the worst case is
   167→	// redundant transcript content in a condensation, not data loss.
   168→	s.CondensedTranscriptLines = 0
   169→	s.TranscriptLinesAtStart = 0
   170→
   171→	// Backfill AttributionBaseCommit for sessions created before this field existed.
   172→	// Without this, a mid-turn commit would migrate BaseCommit and the fallback in
   173→	// calculateSessionAttributions would use the migrated value, producing zero attribution.
   174→	if s.AttributionBaseCommit == "" && s.BaseCommit != "" {
   175→		s.AttributionBaseCommit = s.BaseCommit
   176→	}
   177→}

   179→// StateStore provides low-level operations for managing session state files.
   180→//
   181→// StateStore is a primitive for session state persistence. It is NOT the same as
   182→// the Sessions interface - it only handles state files in .git/entire-sessions/,
   183→// not the full session data which includes checkpoint content.
   184→//
   185→// Use StateStore directly in strategies for performance-critical state operations.
   186→// Use the Sessions interface (when implemented) for high-level session management.
   187→type StateStore struct {
   188→	// stateDir is the directory where session state files are stored
   189→	stateDir string
   190→}
   191→
   192→// NewStateStore creates a new state store.
   193→// Uses the git common dir to store session state (shared across worktrees).
   194→func NewStateStore() (*StateStore, error) {
   195→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir()
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   198→	}
   199→	return &StateStore{
   200→		stateDir: filepath.Join(commonDir, SessionStateDirName),
   201→	}, nil

   204→// NewStateStoreWithDir creates a new state store with a custom directory.

   210→// Load loads the session state for the given session ID.
   211→// Returns (nil, nil) when session file doesn't exist (not an error condition).
   212→func (s *StateStore) Load(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*State, error) {
   213→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   214→
   215→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   216→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   217→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   218→	}
   219→
   220→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   221→
   222→	data, err := os.ReadFile(stateFile) //nolint:gosec // stateFile is derived from sessionID
   223→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   224→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   225→	}
   226→	if err != nil {
   227→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   228→	}
   229→
   230→	var state State
   231→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   232→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   233→	}
   234→	state.NormalizeAfterLoad()
   235→	return &state, nil
   236→}

   238→// Save saves the session state atomically.
   239→func (s *StateStore) Save(ctx context.Context, state *State) error {
   240→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   241→
   242→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   243→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   244→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   245→	}
   246→
   247→	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.stateDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   248→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)
   249→	}
   250→
   251→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(state, "", "  ")
   252→	if err != nil {
   253→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   254→	}
   255→
   256→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)
   257→
   258→	// Atomic write: write to temp file, then rename
   259→	tmpFile := stateFile + ".tmp"
   260→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   261→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   262→	}
   263→	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, stateFile); err != nil {
   264→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to rename session state file: %w", err)
   265→	}
   266→	return nil
   267→}

   269→// Clear removes the session state file for the given session ID.
   270→func (s *StateStore) Clear(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   271→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   272→
   273→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   274→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   275→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   276→	}
   277→
   278→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   279→
   280→	if err := os.Remove(stateFile); err != nil {
   281→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   282→			return nil // Already gone, not an error
   283→		}
   284→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state file: %w", err)
   285→	}
   286→	return nil
   287→}

   289→// RemoveAll removes the entire session state directory.
   290→// This is used during uninstall to completely remove all session state.
   291→func (s *StateStore) RemoveAll() error {
   292→	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.stateDir); err != nil {
   293→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state directory: %w", err)
   294→	}
   295→	return nil
   296→}
   297→
   298→// List returns all session states.
   299→func (s *StateStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]*State, error) {
   300→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   301→
   302→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.stateDir)
   303→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   304→		return nil, nil
   305→	}
   306→	if err != nil {
   307→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state directory: %w", err)
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	var states []*State
   311→	for _, entry := range entries {
   312→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   313→			continue
   314→		}
   315→		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") {
   316→			continue // Skip temp files
   317→		}
   318→
   319→		sessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   320→		state, err := s.Load(ctx, sessionID)
   321→		if err != nil {
   322→			continue // Skip corrupted state files
   323→		}
   324→		if state == nil {
   325→			continue
   326→		}
   327→
   328→		states = append(states, state)
   329→	}
   330→	return states, nil
   331→}

   333→// stateFilePath returns the path to a session state file.
   334→func (s *StateStore) stateFilePath(sessionID string) string {
   335→	return filepath.Join(s.stateDir, sessionID+".json")
   336→}

   338→// getGitCommonDir returns the path to the shared git directory.
   339→// In a regular checkout, this is .git/
   340→// In a worktree, this is the main repo's .git/ (not .git/worktrees/<name>/)
   341→func getGitCommonDir() (string, error) {
   342→	ctx := context.Background()
   343→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
   344→	cmd.Dir = "."
   345→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   346→	if err != nil {
   347→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   348→	}
   349→
   350→	commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
   351→
   352→	// git rev-parse --git-common-dir returns relative paths from the working directory,
   353→	// so we need to make it absolute if it isn't already
   354→	if !filepath.IsAbs(commonDir) {
   355→		commonDir = filepath.Join(".", commonDir)
   356→	}
   357→
   358→	return filepath.Clean(commonDir), nil
   359→}

    17→// that changes HEAD mid-session (via a tool call), without a new prompt being submitted.
    18→// Without this migration, checkpoints would be saved to an orphaned shadow branch.
    19→//
    20→// Returns true if migration occurred, false otherwise.
    21→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
    22→	if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" {
    23→		return false, nil
    24→	}
    25→
    26→	head, err := repo.Head()
    27→	if err != nil {
    28→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
    29→	}
    30→
    31→	currentHead := head.Hash().String()
    32→	if state.BaseCommit == currentHead {
    33→		return false, nil // No migration needed
    34→	}
    35→
    36→	// HEAD changed - check if old shadow branch exists and migrate it
    37→	oldShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
    38→	newShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(currentHead, state.WorktreeID)
    39→
    40→	// Guard against hash prefix collision: if both commits produce the same
    41→	// shadow branch name (same 7-char prefix), just update state - no ref rename needed
    42→	if oldShadowBranch == newShadowBranch {
    43→		state.BaseCommit = currentHead
    44→		return true, nil
    45→	}
    46→
    47→	oldRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(oldShadowBranch)
    48→	oldRef, err := repo.Reference(oldRefName, true)
    49→	if err != nil {
    50→		// Old shadow branch doesn't exist - just update state.BaseCommit
    51→		// This can happen if this is the first checkpoint after HEAD changed
    52→		state.BaseCommit = currentHead
    53→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session base commit to %s (HEAD changed during session)\n", currentHead[:7])
    54→		return true, nil //nolint:nilerr // err is "reference not found" which is fine - just need to update state
    55→	}
    56→
    57→	// Old shadow branch exists - move it to new base commit
    58→	newRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(newShadowBranch)
    59→
    60→	// Create new reference pointing to same commit as old shadow branch
    61→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(newRefName, oldRef.Hash())
    62→	if err := repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
    63→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to create new shadow branch %s: %w", newShadowBranch, err)
    64→	}
    65→
    66→	// Delete old reference via CLI (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
    67→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(oldShadowBranch); err != nil {
    68→		// Non-fatal: log but continue - the important thing is the new branch exists
    69→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to remove old shadow branch %s: %v\n", oldShadowBranch, err)
    70→	}
    71→
    72→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Moved shadow branch from %s to %s (HEAD changed during session)\n",
    73→		oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch)
    74→
    75→	// Update state with new base commit
    76→	state.BaseCommit = currentHead
    77→	return true, nil
    78→}

    80→// migrateAndPersistIfNeeded checks for HEAD changes, migrates the shadow branch if needed,
    81→// and persists the updated session state. Used by SaveChanges and SaveTaskCheckpoint.
    82→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateAndPersistIfNeeded(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) error {
    83→	migrated, err := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, state)
    84→	if err != nil {
    85→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check/migrate shadow branch: %w", err)
    86→	}
    87→	if migrated {
    88→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
    89→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state after migration: %w", err)
    90→		}
    91→	}
    92→	return nil
    93→}

   449→// InitialAttribution captures line-level attribution metrics at commit time.
   450→// This is a point-in-time snapshot comparing the checkpoint tree (agent work)
   451→// against the committed tree (may include human edits).
   452→//
   453→// Attribution Metrics:
   454→//   - TotalCommitted measures "net additions" (lines added that remain in the commit)
   455→//   - AgentPercentage represents "of the new code added, what percentage came from the agent"
   456→//   - Deletion work is tracked separately in HumanRemoved (not included in percentage)
   457→//
   458→// Deletion-Only Commits:
   459→// For commits with only deletions (no additions), TotalCommitted will be 0 and
   460→// AgentPercentage will be 0. This is by design - the percentage metric is only
   461→// meaningful for commits that add code. Deletion contributions are captured in
   462→// the HumanRemoved field but don't affect the attribution percentage.
   463→type InitialAttribution struct {
   464→	CalculatedAt    time.Time `json:"calculated_at"`
   465→	AgentLines      int       `json:"agent_lines"`      // Lines added by agent (base → shadow diff)
   466→	HumanAdded      int       `json:"human_added"`      // Lines added by human (excluding modifications)
   467→	HumanModified   int       `json:"human_modified"`   // Lines modified by human (estimate: min(added, removed))
   468→	HumanRemoved    int       `json:"human_removed"`    // Lines removed by human (excluding modifications)
   469→	TotalCommitted  int       `json:"total_committed"`  // Net additions in commit (agent + human new lines, not total file size)
   470→	AgentPercentage float64   `json:"agent_percentage"` // agent_lines / total_committed * 100 (0 for deletion-only commits)
   471→}

    30→// listCheckpoints returns all checkpoints from the metadata branch.
    31→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.ListCommitted() for reading from entire/checkpoints/v1.
    32→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) listCheckpoints() ([]CheckpointInfo, error) {
    33→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
    34→	if err != nil {
    35→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
    36→	}
    37→
    38→	committed, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
    39→	if err != nil {
    40→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list committed checkpoints: %w", err)
    41→	}
    42→
    43→	// Convert from checkpoint.CommittedInfo to strategy.CheckpointInfo
    44→	result := make([]CheckpointInfo, 0, len(committed))
    45→	for _, c := range committed {
    46→		result = append(result, CheckpointInfo{
    47→			CheckpointID:     c.CheckpointID,
    48→			SessionID:        c.SessionID,
    49→			CreatedAt:        c.CreatedAt,
    50→			CheckpointsCount: c.CheckpointsCount,
    51→			FilesTouched:     c.FilesTouched,
    52→			Agent:            c.Agent,
    53→			IsTask:           c.IsTask,
    54→			ToolUseID:        c.ToolUseID,
    55→			SessionCount:     c.SessionCount,
    56→			SessionIDs:       c.SessionIDs,
    57→		})
    58→	}
    59→
    60→	return result, nil
    61→}

    63→// getCheckpointsForSession returns all checkpoints for a session ID.
    64→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getCheckpointsForSession(sessionID string) ([]CheckpointInfo, error) {
    65→	all, err := s.listCheckpoints()
    66→	if err != nil {
    67→		return nil, err
    68→	}
    69→
    70→	var result []CheckpointInfo
    71→	for _, cp := range all {
    72→		if cp.SessionID == sessionID || strings.HasPrefix(cp.SessionID, sessionID) {
    73→			result = append(result, cp)
    74→		}
    75→	}
    76→
    77→	if len(result) == 0 {
    78→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no checkpoints for session: %s", sessionID)
    79→	}
    80→
    81→	return result, nil
    82→}

    84→// getCheckpointLog returns the transcript for a specific checkpoint ID.
    85→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.ReadCommitted() for reading from entire/checkpoints/v1.
    86→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getCheckpointLog(checkpointID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, error) {
    87→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
    88→	if err != nil {
    89→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
    90→	}
    91→
    92→	content, err := store.ReadLatestSessionContent(context.Background(), checkpointID)
    93→	if err != nil {
    94→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
    95→	}
    96→	if content == nil {
    97→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointID)
    98→	}
    99→	if len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   100→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no transcript found for checkpoint: %s", checkpointID)
   101→	}
   102→
   103→	return content.Transcript, nil
   104→}

   106→// CondenseSession condenses a session's shadow branch to permanent storage.
   107→// checkpointID is the 12-hex-char value from the Entire-Checkpoint trailer.
   108→// Metadata is stored at sharded path: <checkpoint_id[:2]>/<checkpoint_id[2:]>/
   109→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.WriteCommitted for the git operations.
   110→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSession(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, state *SessionState) (*CondenseResult, error) {
   111→	// Get shadow branch
   112→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   113→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   114→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   115→	if err != nil {
   116→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow branch not found: %w", err)
   117→	}
   118→
   119→	// Extract session data from the shadow branch (with live transcript fallback).
   120→	// Use tracked files from session state instead of collecting all files from tree.
   121→	// Pass agent type to handle different transcript formats (JSONL for Claude, JSON for Gemini).
   122→	// Pass live transcript path so condensation reads the current file rather than a
   123→	// potentially stale shadow branch copy (SaveChanges may have been skipped if the
   124→	// last turn had no code changes).
   125→	// Pass CheckpointTranscriptStart for accurate token calculation (line offset for Claude, message index for Gemini).
   126→	sessionData, err := s.extractSessionData(repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, state.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   127→	if err != nil {
   128→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data: %w", err)
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	// Get checkpoint store
   132→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   133→	if err != nil {
   134→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	// Get author info
   138→	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
   139→	attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(repo, ref, sessionData, state)
   140→	// Get current branch name
   141→	branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   142→
   143→	// Generate summary if enabled
   144→	var summary *cpkg.Summary
   145→	if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled() && len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
   146→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   147→		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(logCtx, "summarize")
   148→
   149→		// Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion.
   150→		// SliceFromLine only works for JSONL (Claude Code) transcripts where
   151→		// CheckpointTranscriptStart is a line offset. For Gemini JSON transcripts,
   152→		// CheckpointTranscriptStart is a message index and the transcript is a single
   153→		// JSON blob, so line-based slicing would produce malformed content.
   154→		// The summarizer (ParseFromBytes) only supports JSONL, so skip scoping for Gemini.
   155→		var scopedTranscript []byte
   156→		if state.AgentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   157→			scopedTranscript = sessionData.Transcript
   158→		} else {
   159→			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   160→		}
   161→		if len(scopedTranscript) > 0 {
   162→			var err error
   163→			summary, err = summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, scopedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, nil)
   164→			if err != nil {
   165→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
   166→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   167→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   168→				// Continue without summary - non-blocking
   169→			} else {
   170→				logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
   171→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
   172→			}
   173→		}
   174→	}
   175→
   176→	// Write checkpoint metadata using the checkpoint store
   177→	if err := store.WriteCommitted(context.Background(), cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
   178→		CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   179→		SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   180→		Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   181→		Branch:                      branchName,
   182→		Transcript:                  sessionData.Transcript,
   183→		Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
   184→		Context:                     sessionData.Context,
   185→		FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   186→		CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
   187→		EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
   188→		AuthorName:                  authorName,
   189→		AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
   190→		Agent:                       state.AgentType,
   191→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   192→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   193→		TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
   194→		InitialAttribution:          attribution,
   195→		Summary:                     summary,
   196→		SessionTranscriptPath:       homeRelativePath(state.TranscriptPath),
   197→	}); err != nil {
   198→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   199→	}
   200→
   201→	return &CondenseResult{
   202→		CheckpointID:         checkpointID,
   203→		SessionID:            state.SessionID,
   204→		CheckpointsCount:     state.StepCount,
   205→		FilesTouched:         sessionData.FilesTouched,
   206→		TotalTranscriptLines: sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   207→	}, nil
   208→}

   210→func calculateSessionAttributions(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   211→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   212→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   213→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   214→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   215→	var attribution *cpkg.InitialAttribution
   216→	headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   217→	if headErr != nil {
   218→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   219→			slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   220→	} else {
   221→		headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   222→		if commitErr != nil {
   223→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   224→				slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   225→		} else {
   226→			headTree, treeErr := headCommit.Tree()
   227→			if treeErr != nil {
   228→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   229→					slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   230→			} else {
   231→				// Get shadow branch tree (checkpoint tree - what the agent wrote)
   232→				shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   233→				if shadowErr != nil {
   234→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   235→						slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   236→						slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   237→				} else {
   238→					shadowTree, shadowTreeErr := shadowCommit.Tree()
   239→					if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   240→						logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   241→							slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   242→					} else {
   243→						// Get base tree (state before session started)
   244→						var baseTree *object.Tree
   245→						attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   246→						if attrBase == "" {
   247→							attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
   248→						}
   249→						if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
   250→							if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
   251→								baseTree = tree
   252→							} else {
   253→								logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
   254→									slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
   255→							}
   256→						} else {
   257→							logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
   258→								slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
   259→								slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
   260→						}
   261→
   262→						// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
   263→						var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
   264→						for i, pa := range state.PromptAttributions {
   265→							totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   266→							totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   267→							logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
   268→								slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
   269→								slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
   270→								slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
   271→								slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
   272→								slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
   273→								slog.Int("index", i))
   274→						}
   275→
   276→						attribution = CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   277→							baseTree,
   278→							shadowTree,
   279→							headTree,
   280→							sessionData.FilesTouched,
   281→							state.PromptAttributions,
   282→						)
   283→
   284→						if attribution != nil {
   285→							logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
   286→								slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
   287→								slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
   288→								slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
   289→								slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
   290→								slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
   291→								slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
   292→								slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
   293→								slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
   294→								slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
   295→						}
   296→					}
   297→				}
   298→			}
   299→		}
   300→	}
   301→	return attribution
   302→}

   304→// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
   305→// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
   306→// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
   307→// liveTranscriptPath, when non-empty and readable, is preferred over the shadow branch copy.
   308→// This handles the case where SaveChanges was skipped (no code changes) but the transcript
   309→// continued growing — the shadow branch copy would be stale.
   310→// checkpointTranscriptStart is the line offset (Claude) or message index (Gemini) where the current checkpoint began.
   311→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, filesTouched []string, agentType agent.AgentType, liveTranscriptPath string, checkpointTranscriptStart int) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   312→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
   313→	if err != nil {
   314→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   315→	}
   316→
   317→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   318→	if err != nil {
   319→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   320→	}
   321→
   322→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   323→	// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix)
   324→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   325→
   326→	// Extract transcript — prefer the live file when available, fall back to shadow branch.
   327→	// The shadow branch copy may be stale if the last turn ended without code changes
   328→	// (SaveChanges is only called when there are file modifications).
   329→	var fullTranscript string
   330→	if liveTranscriptPath != "" {
   331→		if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
   332→			fullTranscript = string(liveData)
   333→		}
   334→	}
   335→	if fullTranscript == "" {
   336→		// Fall back to shadow branch copy
   337→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   338→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   339→				fullTranscript = content
   340→			}
   341→		} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   342→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   343→				fullTranscript = content
   344→			}
   345→		}
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   349→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   350→		data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   351→		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
   352→		data.Prompts = extractUserPrompts(agentType, fullTranscript)
   353→		data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   354→	}
   355→
   356→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   357→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   358→
   359→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   360→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   361→		data.TokenUsage = calculateTokenUsage(agentType, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart)
   362→	}
   363→
   364→	return data, nil
   365→}
   366→
   367→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   368→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   369→// For Gemini CLI and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   370→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   371→func countTranscriptItems(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) int {
   372→	if content == "" {
   373→		return 0
   374→	}
   375→
   376→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   377→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   378→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   379→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   380→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   381→		}
   382→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   383→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   384→			return 0
   385→		}
   386→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   390→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   391→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   392→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   393→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   394→	}
   395→	return len(allLines)
   396→}

   398→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   399→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   400→func extractUserPrompts(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) []string {
   401→	if content == "" {
   402→		return nil
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   406→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   407→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   408→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   409→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   410→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   411→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   412→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   413→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   414→				}
   415→			}
   416→			return cleaned
   417→		}
   418→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   419→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   420→			return nil
   421→		}
   422→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   423→	}
   424→
   425→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   426→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   427→}
   428→
   429→// calculateTokenUsage calculates token usage from raw transcript data.
   430→// startOffset is the line number (Claude Code) or message index (Gemini CLI)
   431→// where the current checkpoint began, allowing calculation for only the portion
   432→// of the transcript since the last checkpoint.
   433→func calculateTokenUsage(agentType agent.AgentType, data []byte, startOffset int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   434→	if len(data) == 0 {
   435→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   436→	}
   437→
   438→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   439→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   440→		// Attempt to parse as Gemini JSON
   441→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript(data)
   442→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   443→			return geminicli.CalculateTokenUsage(data, startOffset)
   444→		}
   445→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return empty usage
   446→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   447→			return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   448→		}
   449→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   450→	}
   451→
   452→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   453→	lines, err := claudecode.ParseTranscript(data)
   454→	if err != nil || len(lines) == 0 {
   455→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   456→	}
   457→	// Slice transcript lines to only include checkpoint portion
   458→	if startOffset > 0 && startOffset < len(lines) {
   459→		lines = lines[startOffset:]
   460→	}
   461→	return claudecode.CalculateTokenUsage(lines)
   462→}

   464→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   465→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   466→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   467→	var prompts []string
   468→	for _, line := range lines {
   469→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   470→		if line == "" {
   471→			continue
   472→		}
   473→
   474→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   475→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   476→			continue
   477→		}
   478→
   479→		// Check for user message (supports both "human" and "user" types)
   480→		msgType, ok := entry["type"].(string)
   481→		if !ok || (msgType != "human" && msgType != "user") {
   482→			continue
   483→		}
   484→
   485→		// Extract message content
   486→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   487→		if !ok {
   488→			continue
   489→		}
   490→
   491→		// Handle string content
   492→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   493→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   494→			if cleaned != "" {
   495→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   496→			}
   497→			continue
   498→		}
   499→
   500→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   501→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   502→			var texts []string
   503→			for _, item := range arr {
   504→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   505→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   506→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   507→							texts = append(texts, text)
   508→						}
   509→					}
   510→				}
   511→			}
   512→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   513→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   514→				if cleaned != "" {
   515→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   516→				}
   517→			}
   518→		}
   519→	}
   520→	return prompts
   521→}
   522→
   523→// generateContextFromPrompts generates context.md content from a list of prompts.
   524→func generateContextFromPrompts(prompts []string) []byte {
   525→	if len(prompts) == 0 {
   526→		return nil
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	var buf strings.Builder
   530→	buf.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   531→	buf.WriteString("## User Prompts\n\n")
   532→
   533→	for i, prompt := range prompts {
   534→		// Truncate very long prompts for readability
   535→		displayPrompt := prompt
   536→		if len(displayPrompt) > 500 {
   537→			displayPrompt = displayPrompt[:500] + "..."
   538→		}
   539→		buf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### Prompt %d\n\n", i+1))
   540→		buf.WriteString(displayPrompt)
   541→		buf.WriteString("\n\n")
   542→	}
   543→
   544→	return []byte(buf.String())
   545→}

   547→// CondenseSessionByID force-condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   548→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   549→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(sessionID string) error {
   550→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "condense-by-id")
   551→
   552→	// Load session state
   553→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   554→	if err != nil {
   555→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   556→	}
   557→	if state == nil {
   558→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   559→	}
   560→
   561→	// Open repository
   562→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   563→	if err != nil {
   564→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   565→	}
   566→
   567→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   568→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   569→	if err != nil {
   570→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   571→	}
   572→
   573→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   574→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   575→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   576→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   577→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   578→
   579→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   580→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   581→		// Just clean up the state file.
   582→		logging.Info(ctx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   583→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   584→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   585→		)
   586→		if err := s.clearSessionState(sessionID); err != nil {
   587→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   588→		}
   589→		return nil
   590→	}
   591→
   592→	// Condense the session
   593→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   594→	if err != nil {
   595→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   596→	}
   597→
   598→	logging.Info(ctx, "session condensed by ID",
   599→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   600→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   601→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   602→	)
   603→
   604→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   605→	state.StepCount = 0
   606→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   607→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   608→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   609→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   610→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   611→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   612→
   613→	if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   614→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   615→	}
   616→
   617→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   618→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   619→		logging.Warn(ctx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   620→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   621→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   622→		)
   623→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   624→	}
   625→
   626→	return nil
   627→}

   630→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(_ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   631→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   632→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates()
   633→	if err != nil {
   634→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   635→	}
   636→
   637→	for _, state := range allStates {
   638→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   639→			continue
   640→		}
   641→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   642→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   643→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   644→			return nil
   645→		}
   646→	}
   647→
   648→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   649→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   650→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   651→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   652→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   653→			return nil
   654→		}
   655→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   656→	}
   657→	return nil
   658→}

   341→func getGitCommonDir() (string, error) {

    23→// TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_NoCondensation verifies that PostCommit on an
    24→// ACTIVE session transitions to ACTIVE_COMMITTED without condensing.
    25→// The shadow branch must be preserved because the session is still active.

    27→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
    28→	t.Chdir(dir)
    29→
    30→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
    31→	require.NoError(t, err)
    32→
    33→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
    34→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-active"
    35→
    36→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint so there is shadow branch content
    37→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
    38→
    39→	// Set phase to ACTIVE (simulating agent mid-turn)
    40→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
    41→	require.NoError(t, err)
    42→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
    43→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
    44→
    45→	// Create a commit WITH the Entire-Checkpoint trailer on the main branch
    46→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "a1b2c3d4e5f6")
    47→

    49→	err = s.PostCommit()
    50→	require.NoError(t, err)
    51→

    53→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
    54→	require.NoError(t, err)
    55→	require.NotNil(t, state)
    56→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state.Phase,

    59→	// Verify shadow branch is NOT deleted (session is still active).
    60→	// After PostCommit, BaseCommit is updated to new HEAD, so use the current state.
    61→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
    62→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
    63→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)

    65→		"shadow branch should be preserved when session is still active")
    66→}

  1016→// TestTurnEnd_DeferredCondensation_AttributionUsesOriginalBase verifies that
  1017→// deferred condensation (ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE) uses AttributionBaseCommit
  1018→// instead of BaseCommit for attribution, so the diff is non-zero.
  1019→//
  1020→// Scenario: agent modifies a file, user commits mid-turn, then turn ends.
  1021→// Without the fix, BaseCommit is updated to the new HEAD by PostCommit migration,
  1022→// so baseTree == headTree and attribution shows zero changes.
  1023→// With the fix, AttributionBaseCommit preserves the original base commit.
  1024→func TestTurnEnd_DeferredCondensation_AttributionUsesOriginalBase(t *testing.T) {
  1025→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
  1026→	t.Chdir(dir)
  1027→
  1028→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
  1029→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1030→
  1031→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
  1032→	sessionID := "test-deferred-attribution"
  1033→
  1034→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint that includes a modified file.
  1035→	// The "agent" modifies test.txt before saving the checkpoint.
  1036→	setupSessionWithFileChange(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
  1037→
  1038→	// Record the original base commit (commit A)
  1039→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
  1040→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1041→	originalBaseCommit := state.BaseCommit
  1042→
  1043→	// Verify AttributionBaseCommit is set at session init
  1044→	assert.Equal(t, originalBaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1045→		"AttributionBaseCommit should equal BaseCommit at session start")
  1046→
  1047→	// Set phase to ACTIVE (simulating agent mid-turn)
  1048→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
  1049→	state.FilesTouched = []string{"test.txt"}
  1050→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
  1051→
  1052→	// User commits (creates commit B). This triggers PostCommit which:
  1053→	// - Transitions ACTIVE → ACTIVE_COMMITTED (defers condensation)
  1054→	// - Migrates shadow branch to new HEAD
  1055→	// - Updates BaseCommit to new HEAD
  1056→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "a1b2c3d4e5f6")
  1057→
  1058→	err = s.PostCommit()
  1059→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1060→
  1061→	// Reload state and verify the key invariant:
  1062→	// BaseCommit has moved to the new HEAD, but AttributionBaseCommit stays at original
  1063→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
  1064→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1065→	require.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state.Phase)
  1066→
  1067→	head, err := repo.Head()
  1068→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1069→	newHeadHash := head.Hash().String()
  1070→
  1071→	assert.Equal(t, newHeadHash, state.BaseCommit,
  1072→		"BaseCommit should be updated to new HEAD after migration")
  1073→	assert.Equal(t, originalBaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1074→		"AttributionBaseCommit should still point to original base (commit A)")
  1075→	assert.NotEqual(t, state.BaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1076→		"BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit should diverge after mid-turn commit")
  1077→
  1078→	// Now simulate TurnEnd (agent finishes) — deferred condensation runs
  1079→	result := session.Transition(state.Phase, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{})
  1080→	remaining := session.ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
  1081→	require.Contains(t, remaining, session.ActionCondense)
  1082→
  1083→	err = s.HandleTurnEnd(state, remaining)
  1084→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1085→
  1086→	// After condensation, verify AttributionBaseCommit is updated to match BaseCommit
  1087→	assert.Equal(t, state.BaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1088→		"AttributionBaseCommit should be updated after successful condensation")
  1089→
  1090→	// Verify condensation actually happened
  1091→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
  1092→	require.NoError(t, err, "entire/sessions branch should exist after deferred condensation")
  1093→
  1094→	// Read back the committed metadata and verify attribution is non-zero.
  1095→	// The agent modified test.txt (added a line), so AgentLines should be > 0.
  1096→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1097→	cpID := id.MustCheckpointID("a1b2c3d4e5f6")
  1098→	content, err := store.ReadSessionContent(context.Background(), cpID, 0)
  1099→	require.NoError(t, err, "should be able to read condensed session content")
  1100→	require.NotNil(t, content)
  1101→	require.NotNil(t, content.Metadata.InitialAttribution,
  1102→		"condensed metadata should include attribution")
  1103→	assert.Positive(t, content.Metadata.InitialAttribution.TotalCommitted,
  1104→		"attribution TotalCommitted should be non-zero (agent modified test.txt)")
  1105→}

Update the test file `/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/phase_postcommit_test.go` to match the new 1:1 checkpoint model. The key changes:

**Removed concepts:**
- `ACTIVE_COMMITTED` phase no longer exists
- `PendingCheckpointID` field no longer exists on session state
- `ActionMigrateShadowBranch` no longer exists
- Deferred condensation no longer exists (no HandleTurnEnd with ActionCondense)
- Shadow branch migration via PostCommit no longer exists

**New behavior:**
- `ACTIVE + GitCommit → ACTIVE + ActionCondense` (immediate condensation, stays active)
- After condensation for an ACTIVE session, if uncommitted files remain, carry-forward creates a new shadow branch
- No deferred condensation at TurnEnd

**Tests to DELETE entirely** (they test removed concepts):
1. `TestPostCommit_ActiveCommitted_MigratesShadowBranch` — no ACTIVE_COMMITTED
2. `TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_SetsPendingCheckpointID` — no PendingCheckpointID
3. `TestTurnEnd_ActiveCommitted_ReusesCheckpointID` — no ACTIVE_COMMITTED/PendingCheckpointID
4. `TestTurnEnd_ConcurrentSession_PreservesShadowBranch` — tests ACTIVE_COMMITTED deferred condensation
5. `TestTurnEnd_ActiveCommitted_CondensesSession` — no deferred condensation
6. `TestTurnEnd_ActiveCommitted_CondensationFailure_PreservesShadowBranch` — no deferred condensation
7. `TestTurnEnd_DeferredCondensation_AttributionUsesOriginalBase` — no deferred condensation

**Tests to UPDATE:**

1. `TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_NoCondensation` → Rewrite as `TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_CondensesImmediately`:
   - ACTIVE session should now CONDENSE on GitCommit (not defer)
   - Phase should stay `PhaseActive` (not transition to ACTIVE_COMMITTED)
   - The `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch should exist after condensation
   - StepCount should be reset to 0

2. `TestPostCommit_ShadowBranch_PreservedWhenActiveSessionExists` → Update:
   - The ACTIVE session now condenses immediately (not defers)
   - Phase stays `PhaseActive` (not ACTIVE_COMMITTED)
   - Shadow branch behavior: after condensation, if no other sessions use it, old shadow is deleted. New shadow may exist if carry-forward created one.
   - Remove assertion about `PhaseActiveCommitted`
   - The key thing to test: when multiple sessions share a shadow branch, the branch is preserved if an uncondensed active session still needs it.

**Test to KEEP unchanged:**
- `TestPostCommit_IdleSession_Condenses`
- `TestPostCommit_RebaseDuringActive_SkipsTransition`  
- `TestPostCommit_CondensationFailure_PreservesShadowBranch`
- `TestPostCommit_IdleSession_NoNewContent_UpdatesBaseCommit`
- `TestPostCommit_EndedSession_FilesTouched_Condenses`
- `TestPostCommit_EndedSession_FilesTouched_NoNewContent`
- `TestPostCommit_EndedSession_NoFilesTouched_Discards`
- `TestPostCommit_CondensationFailure_EndedSession_PreservesShadowBranch`
- `TestPostCommit_FilesTouched_ResetsAfterCondensation`
- `TestTurnEnd_Active_NoActions`

Also keep helper functions: `setupSessionWithCheckpoint`, `setupSessionWithFileChange`, `commitWithCheckpointTrailer`.

**IMPORTANT**: 
- `session.PhaseActiveCommitted` no longer exists — remove ALL references
- `state.PendingCheckpointID` field no longer exists — remove ALL references

- Deferred condensation no longer exists (no HandleTurnEnd with ActionCondense)
- Shadow branch migration via PostCommit no longer exists

**New behavior:**
- `ACTIVE + GitCommit → ACTIVE + ActionCondense` (immediate condensation, stays active)
- After condensation for an ACTIVE session, if uncommitted files remain, carry-forward creates a new shadow branch
- No deferred condensation at TurnEnd

**Tests to DELETE entirely** (they test removed concepts):
1. `TestPostCommit_ActiveCommitted_MigratesShadowBranch` — no ACTIVE_COMMITTED
2. `TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_SetsPendingCheckpointID` — no PendingCheckpointID

5. `TestTurnEnd_ActiveCommitted_CondensesSession` — no deferred condensation
6. `TestTurnEnd_ActiveCommitted_CondensationFailure_PreservesShadowBranch` — no deferred condensation
7. `TestTurnEnd_DeferredCondensation_AttributionUsesOriginalBase` — no deferred condensation

1. `TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_NoCondensation` → Rewrite as `TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_CondensesImmediately`:
   - ACTIVE session should now CONDENSE on GitCommit (not defer)
   - Phase should stay `PhaseActive` (not transition to ACTIVE_COMMITTED)
   - The `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch should exist after condensation
   - StepCount should be reset to 0

2. `TestPostCommit_ShadowBranch_PreservedWhenActiveSessionExists` → Update:
   - The ACTIVE session now condenses immediately (not defers)
   - Phase stays `PhaseActive` (not ACTIVE_COMMITTED)
   - Shadow branch behavior: after condensation, if no other sessions use it, old shadow is deleted. New shadow may exist if carry-forward created one.
   - Remove assertion about `PhaseActiveCommitted`

    25→// The shadow branch must be preserved because the session is still active.
    26→func TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_NoCondensation(t *testing.T) {
    27→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
    28→	t.Chdir(dir)

    30→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
    31→	require.NoError(t, err)

    46→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "a1b2c3d4e5f6")

    57→		"ACTIVE session should transition to ACTIVE_COMMITTED on GitCommit")
    58→

    60→	// After PostCommit, BaseCommit is updated to new HEAD, so use the current state.
    61→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
    62→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)

  1016→// TestTurnEnd_DeferredCondensation_AttributionUsesOriginalBase verifies that
  1017→// deferred condensation (ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE) uses AttributionBaseCommit
  1018→// instead of BaseCommit for attribution, so the diff is non-zero.
  1019→//
  1020→// Scenario: agent modifies a file, user commits mid-turn, then turn ends.
  1021→// Without the fix, BaseCommit is updated to the new HEAD by PostCommit migration,
  1022→// so baseTree == headTree and attribution shows zero changes.
  1023→// With the fix, AttributionBaseCommit preserves the original base commit.
  1024→func TestTurnEnd_DeferredCondensation_AttributionUsesOriginalBase(t *testing.T) {
  1025→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
  1026→	t.Chdir(dir)
  1027→
  1028→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
  1029→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1030→
  1031→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
  1032→	sessionID := "test-deferred-attribution"
  1033→
  1034→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint that includes a modified file.
  1035→	// The "agent" modifies test.txt before saving the checkpoint.
  1036→	setupSessionWithFileChange(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
  1037→
  1038→	// Record the original base commit (commit A)
  1039→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
  1040→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1041→	originalBaseCommit := state.BaseCommit
  1042→
  1043→	// Verify AttributionBaseCommit is set at session init
  1044→	assert.Equal(t, originalBaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1045→		"AttributionBaseCommit should equal BaseCommit at session start")
  1046→
  1047→	// Set phase to ACTIVE (simulating agent mid-turn)
  1048→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
  1049→	state.FilesTouched = []string{"test.txt"}
  1050→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
  1051→
  1052→	// User commits (creates commit B). This triggers PostCommit which:
  1053→	// - Transitions ACTIVE → ACTIVE_COMMITTED (defers condensation)
  1054→	// - Migrates shadow branch to new HEAD
  1055→	// - Updates BaseCommit to new HEAD
  1056→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "a1b2c3d4e5f6")
  1057→
  1058→	err = s.PostCommit()
  1059→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1060→
  1061→	// Reload state and verify the key invariant:
  1062→	// BaseCommit has moved to the new HEAD, but AttributionBaseCommit stays at original
  1063→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
  1064→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1065→	require.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state.Phase)
  1066→
  1067→	head, err := repo.Head()
  1068→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1069→	newHeadHash := head.Hash().String()
  1070→
  1071→	assert.Equal(t, newHeadHash, state.BaseCommit,
  1072→		"BaseCommit should be updated to new HEAD after migration")
  1073→	assert.Equal(t, originalBaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1074→		"AttributionBaseCommit should still point to original base (commit A)")
  1075→	assert.NotEqual(t, state.BaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1076→		"BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit should diverge after mid-turn commit")
  1077→
  1078→	// Now simulate TurnEnd (agent finishes) — deferred condensation runs
  1079→	result := session.Transition(state.Phase, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{})
  1080→	remaining := session.ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
  1081→	require.Contains(t, remaining, session.ActionCondense)
  1082→
  1083→	err = s.HandleTurnEnd(state, remaining)
  1084→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1085→
  1086→	// After condensation, verify AttributionBaseCommit is updated to match BaseCommit
  1087→	assert.Equal(t, state.BaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1088→		"AttributionBaseCommit should be updated after successful condensation")
  1089→
  1090→	// Verify condensation actually happened
  1091→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
  1092→	require.NoError(t, err, "entire/sessions branch should exist after deferred condensation")
  1093→
  1094→	// Read back the committed metadata and verify attribution is non-zero.
  1095→	// The agent modified test.txt (added a line), so AgentLines should be > 0.
  1096→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1097→	cpID := id.MustCheckpointID("a1b2c3d4e5f6")
  1098→	content, err := store.ReadSessionContent(context.Background(), cpID, 0)
  1099→	require.NoError(t, err, "should be able to read condensed session content")
  1100→	require.NotNil(t, content)
  1101→	require.NotNil(t, content.Metadata.InitialAttribution,
  1102→		"condensed metadata should include attribution")
  1103→	assert.Positive(t, content.Metadata.InitialAttribution.TotalCommitted,
  1104→		"attribution TotalCommitted should be non-zero (agent modified test.txt)")

    52→	// In test mode, don't try to interact with the real TTY — just use the default.
    53→	// ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=1 simulates "a human is present" for the hasTTY() check

    59→	// Open /dev/tty for both reading and writing

    85→	response, err := reader.ReadString('\n')

   102→// CommitMsg is called by the git commit-msg hook after the user edits the message.
   103→// If the message contains only our trailer (no actual user content), strip it
   104→// so git will abort the commit due to empty message.
   105→//
   106→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   107→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CommitMsg(commitMsgFile string) error {
   108→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from git hook
   109→	if err != nil {
   110→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   111→	}
   112→
   113→	message := string(content)
   114→
   115→	// Check if our trailer is present (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   116→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); !found {
   117→		// No trailer, nothing to do
   118→		return nil
   119→	}
   120→
   121→	// Check if there's any user content (non-comment, non-trailer lines)
   122→	if !hasUserContent(message) {
   123→		// No user content - strip the trailer so git aborts
   124→		message = stripCheckpointTrailer(message)
   125→		if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   126→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   127→		}
   128→	}
   129→
   130→	return nil
   131→}

   133→// hasUserContent checks if the message has any content besides comments and our trailer.
   134→func hasUserContent(message string) bool {
   135→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   136→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   137→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   138→		// Skip empty lines
   139→		if trimmed == "" {
   140→			continue
   141→		}
   142→		// Skip comment lines
   143→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") {
   144→			continue
   145→		}
   146→		// Skip our trailer line
   147→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, trailerPrefix) {
   148→			continue
   149→		}
   150→		// Found user content
   151→		return true
   152→	}
   153→	return false
   154→}
   155→
   156→// stripCheckpointTrailer removes the Entire-Checkpoint trailer line from the message.
   157→func stripCheckpointTrailer(message string) string {
   158→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   159→	var result []string
   160→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   161→		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), trailerPrefix) {
   162→			result = append(result, line)
   163→		}
   164→	}
   165→	return strings.Join(result, "\n")
   166→}

   373→// handleAmendCommitMsg handles the prepare-commit-msg hook for amend operations
   374→// (source="commit"). It preserves existing trailers or restores from LastCheckpointID.
   375→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error {
   376→	// Read current commit message
   377→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   378→	if err != nil {
   379→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   380→	}
   381→
   382→	message := string(content)
   383→
   384→	// If message already has a trailer, keep it unchanged
   385→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   386→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend preserves existing trailer",
   387→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   388→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   389→		)
   390→		return nil
   391→	}
   392→
   393→	// No trailer in message — check if any session has LastCheckpointID to restore
   394→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   395→	if err != nil {
   396→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   397→	}
   398→
   399→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   400→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   401→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions - nothing to restore
   402→	}
   403→
   404→	// For amend, HEAD^ is the commit being amended, and HEAD is where we are now.
   405→	// We need to match sessions whose BaseCommit equals HEAD (the commit being amended
   406→	// was created from this base). This prevents stale sessions from injecting
   407→	// unrelated checkpoint IDs.
   408→	repo, repoErr := OpenRepository()
   409→	if repoErr != nil {
   410→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   411→	}
   412→	head, headErr := repo.Head()
   413→	if headErr != nil {
   414→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   415→	}
   416→	currentHead := head.Hash().String()
   417→
   418→	// Find first matching session with LastCheckpointID to restore.
   419→	// LastCheckpointID is set after condensation completes.
   420→	for _, state := range sessions {
   421→		if state.BaseCommit != currentHead {
   422→			continue
   423→		}
   424→		if state.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   425→			continue
   426→		}
   427→		cpID := state.LastCheckpointID
   428→		source := "LastCheckpointID"
   429→
   430→		// Restore the trailer
   431→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   432→		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   433→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   434→		}

   436→		logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: restored trailer on amend",
   437→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   438→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   439→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   440→			slog.String("source", source),
   441→		)
   442→		return nil
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	// No checkpoint ID found - leave message unchanged
   446→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend with no checkpoint to restore",
   447→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   448→	)

   452→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   453→// Uses the session state machine to determine what action to take per session:
   454→//   - ACTIVE → condense immediately (each commit gets its own checkpoint)
   455→//   - IDLE → condense immediately
   456→//   - ENDED → condense if files touched, discard if empty
   457→//

   459→// carried forward to a new shadow branch so the next commit gets its own checkpoint.

   461→// Shadow branches are only deleted when ALL sessions sharing the branch are non-active
   462→// and were condensed during this PostCommit.

   466→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit() error {

   472→	}

   477→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   478→	}

   482→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   483→	}

   486→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)

   489→		// Still update BaseCommit for active sessions so future commits can match.
   490→		s.postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(logCtx, head)
   491→		return nil
   492→	}

   494→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   495→	if err != nil {
   496→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   497→	}

   503→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   504→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),

   507→	}

   513→	}

   522→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})

   528→
   529→	for _, state := range sessions {
   530→		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   531→
   532→		// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   533→		// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   534→		// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   535→		hasNew, contentErr := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   536→		if contentErr != nil {
   537→			hasNew = true
   538→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   539→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   540→				slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   541→			)
   542→		}
   543→		transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   544→
   545→		// Run the state machine transition
   546→		remaining := TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventGitCommit, transitionCtx)
   547→
   548→		// Save FilesTouched BEFORE the action loop — condensation clears it,
   549→		// but we need the original list for carry-forward computation.
   550→		filesTouchedBefore := make([]string, len(state.FilesTouched))
   551→		copy(filesTouchedBefore, state.FilesTouched)
   552→
   553→		condensed := false
   554→
   555→		// Dispatch strategy-specific actions.
   556→		// Each branch handles its own BaseCommit update so there is no
   557→		// fallthrough conditional at the end. On condensation failure,
   558→		// BaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated to preserve access to
   559→		// the shadow branch (which is named after the old BaseCommit).
   560→		for _, action := range remaining {
   561→			switch action {
   562→			case session.ActionCondense:
   563→				if hasNew {
   564→					s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   565→					condensed = true
   566→					// condenseAndUpdateState updates BaseCommit on success.
   567→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved so the shadow branch remains accessible.
   568→				} else {
   569→					// No new content to condense — just update BaseCommit
   570→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   571→				}
   572→			case session.ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched:
   573→				// The state machine already gates this action on HasFilesTouched,
   574→				// but hasNew is an additional content-level check (transcript has
   575→				// new content beyond what was previously condensed).
   576→				if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && hasNew {
   577→					s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   578→					condensed = true
   579→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved (same as ActionCondense).
   580→				} else {
   581→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   582→				}
   583→			case session.ActionDiscardIfNoFiles:
   584→				if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   585→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   586→						slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   587→					)
   588→				}
   589→				s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   590→			case session.ActionClearEndedAt, session.ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
   591→				// Handled by session.ApplyCommonActions above
   592→			case session.ActionWarnStaleSession:
   593→				// Not produced by EventGitCommit; listed for switch exhaustiveness
   594→			}
   595→		}
   596→
   597→		// After condensation, carry forward remaining uncommitted files for ACTIVE sessions.
   598→		// This ensures that if the agent touched 3 files but only 2 were committed,
   599→		// the third file still has a shadow branch so the next commit gets its own checkpoint.
   600→		if condensed && state.Phase.IsActive() {
   601→			remainingFiles := subtractFiles(filesTouchedBefore, committedFileSet)
   602→			if len(remainingFiles) > 0 {
   603→				s.carryForwardToNewShadowBranch(logCtx, repo, state, remainingFiles)
   604→			}
   605→		}
   606→
   607→		// Save the updated state
   608→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   609→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   610→		}
   611→
   612→		// Only preserve shadow branch for active sessions that were NOT condensed.
   613→		// Condensed sessions already have their data on entire/checkpoints/v1.
   614→		if state.Phase.IsActive() && !condensed {
   615→			uncondensedActiveOnBranch[shadowBranchName] = true
   616→		}
   617→	}
   618→
   619→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   620→	// or were condensed during this PostCommit.
   621→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   622→		if uncondensedActiveOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   623→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   624→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   625→			)
   626→			continue
   627→		}
   628→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   629→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to clean up %s: %v\n", shadowBranchName, err)
   630→		} else {
   631→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Cleaned up shadow branch: %s\n", shadowBranchName)
   632→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   633→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   634→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   635→			)
   636→		}
   637→	}
   638→
   639→	return nil
   640→}
   641→
   642→// condenseAndUpdateState runs condensation for a session and updates state afterward.
   643→// Returns true if condensation succeeded.
   644→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) condenseAndUpdateState(
   645→	logCtx context.Context,
   646→	repo *git.Repository,
   647→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   648→	state *SessionState,
   649→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   650→	shadowBranchName string,
   651→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   652→) {
   653→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   654→	if err != nil {
   655→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: condensation failed for session %s: %v\n",
   656→			state.SessionID, err)
   657→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: condensation failed",
   658→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   659→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   660→		)
   661→		return
   662→	}
   663→
   664→	// Track this shadow branch for cleanup
   665→	shadowBranchesToDelete[shadowBranchName] = struct{}{}
   666→
   667→	// Update session state for the new base commit
   668→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   669→	state.BaseCommit = newHead
   670→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = newHead
   671→	state.StepCount = 0
   672→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   673→
   674→	// Clear attribution tracking — condensation already used these values
   675→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   676→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   677→	state.FilesTouched = nil
   678→
   679→	// Save checkpoint ID so subsequent commits can reuse it (e.g., amend restores trailer)
   680→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   681→
   682→	shortID := state.SessionID
   683→	if len(shortID) > 8 {
   684→		shortID = shortID[:8]
   685→	}
   686→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Condensed session %s: %s (%d checkpoints)\n",
   687→		shortID, result.CheckpointID, result.CheckpointsCount)
   688→
   689→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed",
   690→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   691→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   692→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   693→		slog.Int("transcript_lines", result.TotalTranscriptLines),
   694→	)
   695→}

   697→// updateBaseCommitIfChanged updates BaseCommit to newHead if it changed.
   698→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx context.Context, state *SessionState, newHead string) {
   699→	if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   700→		state.BaseCommit = newHead
   701→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: updated BaseCommit",
   702→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   703→			slog.String("new_head", truncateHash(newHead)),
   704→		)
   705→	}
   706→}
   707→
   708→// postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly updates BaseCommit for all sessions on the current
   709→// worktree when a commit has no Entire-Checkpoint trailer. This prevents BaseCommit
   710→// from going stale, which would cause future PrepareCommitMsg calls to skip the
   711→// session (BaseCommit != currentHeadHash filter).
   712→//
   713→// Unlike the full PostCommit flow, this does NOT fire EventGitCommit or trigger
   714→// condensation — it only keeps BaseCommit in sync with HEAD.
   715→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(logCtx context.Context, head *plumbing.Reference) {
   716→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   717→	if err != nil {
   718→		return // Silent failure — hooks must be resilient
   719→	}
   720→
   721→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   722→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   723→		return
   724→	}
   725→
   726→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   727→	for _, state := range sessions {
   728→		// Only update active sessions. Idle/ended sessions are kept around for
   729→		// LastCheckpointID reuse and should not be advanced to HEAD.
   730→		if !state.Phase.IsActive() {
   731→			continue
   732→		}
   733→		if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   734→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit (no trailer): updating BaseCommit",
   735→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   736→				slog.String("old_base", truncateHash(state.BaseCommit)),
   737→				slog.String("new_head", truncateHash(newHead)),
   738→			)
   739→			state.BaseCommit = newHead
   740→			if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   741→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   742→			}
   743→		}
   744→	}
   745→}
   746→
   747→// truncateHash safely truncates a git hash to 7 chars for logging.
   748→func truncateHash(h string) string {
   749→	if len(h) > 7 {
   750→		return h[:7]
   751→	}
   752→	return h
   753→}
