   755→// filterSessionsWithNewContent returns sessions that have new transcript content
   756→// beyond what was already condensed.
   757→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo *git.Repository, sessions []*SessionState) []*SessionState {
   758→	var result []*SessionState
   759→
   760→	for _, state := range sessions {
   761→		hasNew, err := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   762→		if err != nil {
   763→			// On error, include the session (fail open for hooks)
   764→			result = append(result, state)
   765→			continue
   766→		}
   767→		if hasNew {
   768→			result = append(result, state)
   769→		}
   770→	}
   771→
   772→	return result
   773→}
   774→
   775→// sessionHasNewContent checks if a session has new transcript content
   776→// beyond what was already condensed.
   777→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContent(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   778→	// Get shadow branch
   779→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   780→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   781→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   782→	if err != nil {
   783→		// No shadow branch means no Stop has happened since the last condensation.
   784→		// However, the agent may have done work (including commits) without a Stop.
   785→		// Check the live transcript to detect this scenario.
   786→		return s.sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo, state)
   787→	}
   788→
   789→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   790→	if err != nil {
   791→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   792→	}
   793→
   794→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   795→	if err != nil {
   796→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   797→	}
   798→
   799→	// Look for transcript file
   800→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + state.SessionID
   801→	var transcriptLines int
   802→
   803→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   804→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   805→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, content)
   806→		}
   807→	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   808→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   809→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, content)
   810→		}
   811→	}
   812→
   813→	// Has new content if there are more lines than already condensed
   814→	return transcriptLines > state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, nil
   815→}
   816→
   817→// sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript checks if a session has new content
   818→// by examining the live transcript file. This is used when no shadow branch exists
   819→// (i.e., no Stop has happened yet) but the agent may have done work.
   820→//
   821→// Returns true if:
   822→//  1. The transcript has grown since the last condensation, AND
   823→//  2. The new transcript portion contains file modifications, AND
   824→//  3. At least one modified file overlaps with the currently staged files
   825→//
   826→// The overlap check ensures we don't add checkpoint trailers to commits that are
   827→// unrelated to the agent's recent changes.
   828→//
   829→// This handles the scenario where the agent commits mid-session before Stop.
   830→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   831→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   832→
   833→	// Need both transcript path and agent type to analyze
   834→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
   835→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: missing transcript path or agent type",
   836→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   837→			slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
   838→			slog.String("agent_type", string(state.AgentType)),
   839→		)
   840→		return false, nil
   841→	}
   842→
   843→	// Get the agent for transcript analysis
   844→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
   845→	if err != nil {
   846→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Unknown agent type, fail gracefully
   847→	}
   848→
   849→	// Cast to TranscriptAnalyzer
   850→	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
   851→	if !ok {
   852→		return false, nil // Agent doesn't support transcript analysis
   853→	}
   854→
   855→	// Get current transcript position
   856→	currentPos, err := analyzer.GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)
   857→	if err != nil {
   858→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error reading transcript, fail gracefully
   859→	}
   860→
   861→	// Check if transcript has grown since last condensation
   862→	if currentPos <= state.CheckpointTranscriptStart {
   863→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: no new content",
   864→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   865→			slog.Int("current_pos", currentPos),
   866→			slog.Int("start_offset", state.CheckpointTranscriptStart),
   867→		)
   868→		return false, nil // No new content
   869→	}
   870→
   871→	// Transcript has grown - check if there are file modifications in the new portion
   872→	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   873→	if err != nil {
   874→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error parsing transcript, fail gracefully
   875→	}
   876→
   877→	// No file modifications means no new content to checkpoint
   878→	if len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
   879→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: transcript grew but no file modifications",
   880→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   881→		)
   882→		return false, nil
   883→	}
   884→
   885→	// Normalize modified files from absolute to repo-relative paths.
   886→	// Transcript tool_use entries contain absolute paths (e.g., /Users/alex/project/src/main.go)
   887→	// but getStagedFiles returns repo-relative paths (e.g., src/main.go).
   888→	// Use state.WorktreePath (already resolved) to avoid an extra git subprocess.
   889→	basePath := state.WorktreePath
   890→	if basePath == "" {
   891→		if wp, wpErr := GetWorktreePath(); wpErr == nil {
   892→			basePath = wp
   893→		}
   894→	}
   895→	if basePath != "" {
   896→		normalized := make([]string, 0, len(modifiedFiles))
   897→		for _, f := range modifiedFiles {
   898→			if rel := paths.ToRelativePath(f, basePath); rel != "" {
   899→				normalized = append(normalized, rel)
   900→			} else {
   901→				// Already relative or outside repo — keep as-is
   902→				normalized = append(normalized, f)
   903→			}
   904→		}
   905→		modifiedFiles = normalized
   906→	}
   907→
   908→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: found file modifications",
   909→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   910→		slog.Int("modified_files", len(modifiedFiles)),
   911→	)
   912→
   913→	// Check if any modified files overlap with currently staged files
   914→	// This ensures we only add checkpoint trailers to commits that include
   915→	// files the agent actually modified
   916→	stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo)
   917→
   918→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: comparing staged vs modified",
   919→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   920→		slog.Int("staged_files", len(stagedFiles)),
   921→		slog.Int("modified_files", len(modifiedFiles)),
   922→	)
   923→
   924→	if !hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, modifiedFiles) {
   925→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: no overlap between staged and modified files",
   926→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   927→		)
   928→		return false, nil // No overlap - staged files are unrelated to agent's work
   929→	}
   930→
   931→	return true, nil
   932→}

   934→// addTrailerForAgentCommit handles the fast path when an agent is committing
   935→// (ACTIVE session + no TTY). Generates a checkpoint ID and adds the trailer
   936→// directly, bypassing content detection and interactive prompts.
   937→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) addTrailerForAgentCommit(logCtx context.Context, commitMsgFile string, state *SessionState, source string) error {
   938→	cpID, err := id.Generate()
   939→	if err != nil {
   940→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   941→	}
   942→
   943→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   944→	if err != nil {
   945→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   946→	}
   947→
   948→	message := string(content)
   949→
   950→	// Don't add if trailer already exists
   951→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   952→		return nil
   953→	}
   954→
   955→	message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   956→
   957→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: agent commit trailer added",
   958→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   959→		slog.String("source", source),
   960→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   961→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   962→	)
   963→
   964→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   965→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   966→	}
   967→	return nil
   968→}
   969→
   970→// addCheckpointTrailer adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer to a commit message.
   971→// Handles proper trailer formatting (blank line before trailers if needed).
   972→func addCheckpointTrailer(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) string {
   973→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
   974→
   975→	// If message already ends with trailers (lines starting with key:), just append
   976→	// Otherwise, add a blank line first
   977→	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(message, "\n"), "\n")
   978→
   979→	// Check if last non-empty, non-comment line looks like a trailer
   980→	// Git comment lines start with # and may contain ": " (e.g., "# Changes to be committed:")
   981→	hasTrailers := false
   982→	for i := len(lines) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   983→		line := strings.TrimSpace(lines[i])
   984→		if line == "" {
   985→			break
   986→		}
   987→		// Skip git comment lines
   988→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
   989→			continue
   990→		}
   991→		if strings.Contains(line, ": ") {
   992→			hasTrailers = true
   993→			break
   994→		}
   995→		// Non-comment, non-trailer line found - no existing trailers
   996→		break
   997→	}
   998→
   999→	if hasTrailers {
  1000→		// Append trailer directly
  1001→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n" + trailer + "\n"
  1002→	}
  1003→
  1004→	// Add blank line before trailer
  1005→	return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n"
  1006→}
  1007→
  1008→// addCheckpointTrailerWithComment adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer with an explanatory comment.
  1009→// The trailer is placed above the git comment block but below the user's message area,
  1010→// with a comment explaining that the user can remove it if they don't want to link the commit
  1011→// to the agent session. If prompt is non-empty, it's shown as context.
  1012→func addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, agentName, prompt string) string {
  1013→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
  1014→	commentLines := []string{
  1015→		"# Remove the Entire-Checkpoint trailer above if you don't want to link this commit to " + agentName + " session context.",
  1016→	}
  1017→	if prompt != "" {
  1018→		commentLines = append(commentLines, "# Last Prompt: "+prompt)
  1019→	}
  1020→	commentLines = append(commentLines, "# The trailer will be added to your next commit based on this branch.")
  1021→	comment := strings.Join(commentLines, "\n")
  1022→
  1023→	lines := strings.Split(message, "\n")
  1024→
  1025→	// Find where the git comment block starts (first # line)
  1026→	commentStart := -1
  1027→	for i, line := range lines {
  1028→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
  1029→			commentStart = i
  1030→			break
  1031→		}
  1032→	}
  1033→
  1034→	if commentStart == -1 {
  1035→		// No git comments, append trailer at the end
  1036→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n"
  1037→	}
  1038→
  1039→	// Split into user content and git comments
  1040→	userContent := strings.Join(lines[:commentStart], "\n")
  1041→	gitComments := strings.Join(lines[commentStart:], "\n")
  1042→
  1043→	// Build result: user content, blank line, trailer, comment, blank line, git comments
  1044→	userContent = strings.TrimRight(userContent, "\n")
  1045→	if userContent == "" {
  1046→		// No user content yet - leave space for them to type, then trailer
  1047→		// Two newlines: first for user's message line, second for blank separator
  1048→		return "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
  1049→	}
  1050→	return userContent + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
  1051→}

  1053→// InitializeSession creates session state for a new session or updates an existing one.
  1054→// This implements the optional SessionInitializer interface.
  1055→// Called during UserPromptSubmit to allow git hooks to detect active sessions.
  1056→//
  1057→// If the session already exists and HEAD has moved (e.g., user committed), updates
  1058→// BaseCommit to the new HEAD so future checkpoints go to the correct shadow branch.
  1059→//
  1060→// If there's an existing shadow branch with commits from a different session ID,
  1061→// returns a SessionIDConflictError to prevent orphaning existing session work.
  1062→//
  1063→// agentType is the human-readable name of the agent (e.g., "Claude Code").
  1064→// transcriptPath is the path to the live transcript file (for mid-session commit detection).
  1065→// userPrompt is the user's prompt text (stored truncated as FirstPrompt for display).
  1066→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) InitializeSession(sessionID string, agentType agent.AgentType, transcriptPath string, userPrompt string) error {
  1067→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
  1068→	if err != nil {
  1069→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
  1070→	}
  1071→
  1072→	// Check if session already exists
  1073→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
  1074→	if err != nil {
  1075→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check session state: %w", err)
  1076→	}
  1077→
  1078→	if state != nil && state.BaseCommit != "" {
  1079→		// Session is fully initialized — apply phase transition for TurnStart
  1080→		TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1081→
  1082→		// Generate a new TurnID for each turn (correlates carry-forward checkpoints)
  1083→		turnID, err := id.Generate()
  1084→		if err != nil {
  1085→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate turn ID: %w", err)
  1086→		}
  1087→		state.TurnID = turnID.String()
  1088→
  1089→		// Backfill AgentType if empty or set to the generic default "Agent"
  1090→		if !isSpecificAgentType(state.AgentType) && agentType != "" {
  1091→			state.AgentType = agentType
  1092→		}
  1093→
  1094→		// Backfill FirstPrompt if empty (for sessions created before the first_prompt field was added)
  1095→		if state.FirstPrompt == "" && userPrompt != "" {
  1096→			state.FirstPrompt = truncatePromptForStorage(userPrompt)
  1097→		}
  1098→
  1099→		// Update transcript path if provided (may change on session resume)
  1100→		if transcriptPath != "" && state.TranscriptPath != transcriptPath {
  1101→			state.TranscriptPath = transcriptPath
  1102→		}
  1103→
  1104→		// Clear checkpoint IDs on every new prompt
  1105→		// These are set during PostCommit when a checkpoint is created, and should be
  1106→		// cleared when the user enters a new prompt (starting fresh work)
  1107→		if state.LastCheckpointID != "" {
  1108→			state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1109→		}
  1110→
  1111→		// Calculate attribution at prompt start (BEFORE agent makes any changes)
  1112→		// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint (or base commit for first prompt).
  1113→		// IMPORTANT: Always calculate attribution, even for the first checkpoint, to capture
  1114→		// user edits made before the first prompt. The inner CalculatePromptAttribution handles
  1115→		// nil lastCheckpointTree by falling back to baseTree.
  1116→		promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1117→		state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1118→
  1119→		// Check if HEAD has moved (user pulled/rebased or committed)
  1120→		// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded handles renaming the shadow branch and updating state.BaseCommit
  1121→		if _, err := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, state); err != nil {
  1122→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check/migrate shadow branch: %w", err)
  1123→		}
  1124→
  1125→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1126→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update session state: %w", err)
  1127→		}
  1128→		return nil
  1129→	}
  1130→	// If state exists but BaseCommit is empty, it's a partial state from concurrent warning
  1131→	// Continue below to properly initialize it
  1132→
  1133→	// Initialize new session
  1134→	state, err = s.initializeSession(repo, sessionID, agentType, transcriptPath, userPrompt)
  1135→	if err != nil {
  1136→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize session: %w", err)
  1137→	}
  1138→
  1139→	// Apply phase transition: new session starts as ACTIVE
  1140→	TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1141→
  1142→	// Calculate attribution for pre-prompt edits
  1143→	// This captures any user edits made before the first prompt
  1144→	promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1145→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1146→	if err = s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1147→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save attribution: %w", err)
  1148→	}
  1149→
  1150→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Initialized shadow session: %s\n", sessionID)
  1151→	return nil
  1152→}
  1153→
  1154→// calculatePromptAttributionAtStart calculates attribution at prompt start (before agent runs).
  1155→// This captures user changes since the last checkpoint - no filtering needed since
  1156→// the agent hasn't made any changes yet.
  1157→//
  1158→// IMPORTANT: This reads from the worktree (not staging area) to match what WriteTemporary
  1159→// captures in checkpoints. If we read staged content but checkpoints capture worktree content,
  1160→// unstaged changes would be in the checkpoint but not counted in PromptAttribution, causing
  1161→// them to be incorrectly attributed to the agent later.
  1162→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(
  1163→	repo *git.Repository,
  1164→	state *SessionState,
  1165→) PromptAttribution {
  1166→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
  1167→	nextCheckpointNum := state.StepCount + 1
  1168→	result := PromptAttribution{CheckpointNumber: nextCheckpointNum}
  1169→
  1170→	// Get last checkpoint tree from shadow branch (if it exists)
  1171→	// For the first checkpoint, no shadow branch exists yet - this is fine,
  1172→	// CalculatePromptAttribution will use baseTree as the reference instead.
  1173→	var lastCheckpointTree *object.Tree
  1174→	shadowBranchName := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
  1175→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1176→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1177→	if err != nil {
  1178→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: no shadow branch yet (first checkpoint)",
  1179→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName))
  1180→		// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1181→	} else {
  1182→		shadowCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
  1183→		if err != nil {
  1184→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: failed to get shadow commit",
  1185→				slog.String("shadow_ref", ref.Hash().String()),
  1186→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1187→			// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1188→		} else {
  1189→			lastCheckpointTree, err = shadowCommit.Tree()
  1190→			if err != nil {
  1191→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: failed to get shadow tree",
  1192→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1193→				// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1194→			}
  1195→		}
  1196→	}
  1197→
  1198→	// Get base tree for agent lines calculation
  1199→	var baseTree *object.Tree
  1200→	if baseCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(state.BaseCommit)); err == nil {
  1201→		if tree, treeErr := baseCommit.Tree(); treeErr == nil {
  1202→			baseTree = tree
  1203→		} else {
  1204→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: base tree unavailable",
  1205→				slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
  1206→		}
  1207→	} else {
  1208→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: base commit unavailable",
  1209→			slog.String("base_commit", state.BaseCommit),
  1210→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1211→	}
  1212→
  1213→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
  1214→	if err != nil {
  1215→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution skipped: failed to get worktree",
  1216→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1217→		return result
  1218→	}
  1219→
  1220→	// Get worktree status to find ALL changed files
  1221→	status, err := worktree.Status()
  1222→	if err != nil {
  1223→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution skipped: failed to get worktree status",
  1224→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1225→		return result
  1226→	}
  1227→
  1228→	worktreeRoot := worktree.Filesystem.Root()
  1229→
  1230→	// Build map of changed files with their worktree content
  1231→	// IMPORTANT: We read from worktree (not staging area) to match what WriteTemporary
  1232→	// captures in checkpoints. This ensures attribution is consistent.
  1233→	changedFiles := make(map[string]string)
  1234→	for filePath, fileStatus := range status {
  1235→		// Skip unmodified files
  1236→		if fileStatus.Worktree == git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging == git.Unmodified {
  1237→			continue
  1238→		}
  1239→		// Skip .entire metadata directory (session data, not user code)
  1240→		if strings.HasPrefix(filePath, paths.EntireMetadataDir+"/") || strings.HasPrefix(filePath, ".entire/") {
  1241→			continue
  1242→		}
  1243→
  1244→		// Always read from worktree to match checkpoint behavior
  1245→		fullPath := filepath.Join(worktreeRoot, filePath)
  1246→		var content string
  1247→		if data, err := os.ReadFile(fullPath); err == nil { //nolint:gosec // filePath is from git worktree status
  1248→			// Use git's binary detection algorithm (matches getFileContent behavior).
  1249→			// Binary files are excluded from line-based attribution calculations.
  1250→			isBinary, binErr := binary.IsBinary(bytes.NewReader(data))
  1251→			if binErr == nil && !isBinary {
  1252→				content = string(data)
  1253→			}
  1254→		}
  1255→		// else: file deleted, unreadable, or binary - content remains empty string
  1256→
  1257→		changedFiles[filePath] = content
  1258→	}
  1259→
  1260→	// Use CalculatePromptAttribution from manual_commit_attribution.go
  1261→	result = CalculatePromptAttribution(baseTree, lastCheckpointTree, changedFiles, nextCheckpointNum)
  1262→
  1263→	return result
  1264→}

  1266→// getStagedFiles returns a list of files staged for commit.
  1267→func getStagedFiles(repo *git.Repository) []string {
  1268→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
  1269→	if err != nil {
  1270→		return nil
  1271→	}
  1272→
  1273→	status, err := worktree.Status()
  1274→	if err != nil {
  1275→		return nil
  1276→	}
  1277→
  1278→	var staged []string
  1279→	for path, fileStatus := range status {
  1280→		// Check if file is staged (in index)
  1281→		if fileStatus.Staging != git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging != git.Untracked {
  1282→			staged = append(staged, path)
  1283→		}
  1284→	}
  1285→	return staged
  1286→}

  1288→// getLastPrompt retrieves the most recent user prompt from a session's shadow branch.
  1289→// Returns empty string if no prompt can be retrieved.
  1290→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getLastPrompt(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) string {
  1291→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
  1292→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1293→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1294→	if err != nil {
  1295→		return ""
  1296→	}
  1297→
  1298→	// Extract session data to get prompts for commit message generation
  1299→	// Pass agent type to handle different transcript formats (JSONL for Claude, JSON for Gemini)
  1300→	// Pass 0 for checkpointTranscriptStart since we're extracting all prompts, not calculating token usage
  1301→	sessionData, err := s.extractSessionData(repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, nil, state.AgentType, "", 0)
  1302→	if err != nil || len(sessionData.Prompts) == 0 {
  1303→		return ""
  1304→	}
  1305→
  1306→	// Return the last prompt (most recent work before commit)
  1307→	return sessionData.Prompts[len(sessionData.Prompts)-1]
  1308→}
  1309→
  1310→// HandleTurnEnd dispatches strategy-specific actions emitted when an agent turn ends.
  1311→// With immediate condensation in PostCommit, no strategy actions are expected at turn-end.
  1312→//
  1313→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
  1314→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) HandleTurnEnd(state *SessionState, actions []session.Action) error {
  1315→	if len(actions) == 0 {
  1316→		return nil
  1317→	}
  1318→
  1319→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
  1320→
  1321→	for _, action := range actions {
  1322→		switch action {
  1323→		case session.ActionCondense, session.ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched,
  1324→			session.ActionDiscardIfNoFiles, session.ActionWarnStaleSession:
  1325→			// Not expected at turn-end; log for diagnostics.
  1326→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "turn-end: unexpected action",
  1327→				slog.String("action", action.String()),
  1328→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1329→			)
  1330→		case session.ActionClearEndedAt, session.ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
  1331→			// Handled by session.ApplyCommonActions before this is called.
  1332→		}
  1333→	}
  1334→	return nil
  1335→}
  1336→
  1337→// hasOtherActiveSessionsOnBranch checks if any other sessions with the same
  1338→// base commit and worktree ID are in an active phase. Used to prevent deleting
  1339→// a shadow branch that another session still needs.
  1340→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) hasOtherActiveSessionsOnBranch(currentSessionID, baseCommit, worktreeID string) bool {
  1341→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForCommit(baseCommit)
  1342→	if err != nil {
  1343→		return false // Fail-open: if we can't check, don't block deletion
  1344→	}
  1345→	for _, other := range sessions {
  1346→		if other.SessionID == currentSessionID {
  1347→			continue
  1348→		}
  1349→		if other.WorktreeID == worktreeID && other.Phase.IsActive() {
  1350→			return true
  1351→		}
  1352→	}
  1353→	return false
  1354→}
  1355→
  1356→// hasOverlappingFiles checks if any file in stagedFiles appears in filesTouched.
  1357→func hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, filesTouched []string) bool {
  1358→	touchedSet := make(map[string]bool)
  1359→	for _, f := range filesTouched {
  1360→		touchedSet[f] = true
  1361→	}
  1362→
  1363→	for _, staged := range stagedFiles {
  1364→		if touchedSet[staged] {
  1365→			return true
  1366→		}
  1367→	}
  1368→	return false
  1369→}
  1370→
  1371→// filesChangedInCommit returns the set of files changed in a commit by diffing against its parent.
  1372→func filesChangedInCommit(commit *object.Commit) map[string]struct{} {
  1373→	result := make(map[string]struct{})
  1374→
  1375→	commitTree, err := commit.Tree()
  1376→	if err != nil {
  1377→		return result
  1378→	}
  1379→
  1380→	var parentTree *object.Tree
  1381→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
  1382→		parent, err := commit.Parent(0)
  1383→		if err != nil {
  1384→			return result
  1385→		}
  1386→		parentTree, err = parent.Tree()
  1387→		if err != nil {
  1388→			return result
  1389→		}
  1390→	}
  1391→
  1392→	if parentTree == nil {
  1393→		// Initial commit — all files are new
  1394→		if iterErr := commitTree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
  1395→			result[f.Name] = struct{}{}
  1396→			return nil
  1397→		}); iterErr != nil {
  1398→			return result
  1399→		}
  1400→		return result
  1401→	}
  1402→
  1403→	changes, err := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
  1404→	if err != nil {
  1405→		return result
  1406→	}
  1407→	for _, change := range changes {
  1408→		name := change.To.Name
  1409→		if name == "" {
  1410→			name = change.From.Name
  1411→		}
  1412→		result[name] = struct{}{}
  1413→	}
  1414→	return result
  1415→}
  1416→
  1417→// subtractFiles returns files that are NOT in the exclude set.
  1418→func subtractFiles(files []string, exclude map[string]struct{}) []string {
  1419→	var remaining []string
  1420→	for _, f := range files {
  1421→		if _, excluded := exclude[f]; !excluded {
  1422→			remaining = append(remaining, f)
  1423→		}
  1424→	}
  1425→	return remaining
  1426→}
  1427→
  1428→// carryForwardToNewShadowBranch creates a new shadow branch at the current HEAD
  1429→// containing the remaining uncommitted files and all session metadata.
  1430→// This enables the next commit to get its own unique checkpoint.
  1431→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) carryForwardToNewShadowBranch(
  1432→	logCtx context.Context,
  1433→	repo *git.Repository,
  1434→	state *SessionState,
  1435→	remainingFiles []string,
  1436→) {
  1437→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1438→
  1439→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(state.SessionID)
  1440→	metadataDirAbs := filepath.Join(state.WorktreePath, metadataDir)
  1441→
  1442→	result, err := store.WriteTemporary(context.Background(), checkpoint.WriteTemporaryOptions{
  1443→		SessionID:         state.SessionID,
  1444→		BaseCommit:        state.BaseCommit,
  1445→		WorktreeID:        state.WorktreeID,
  1446→		ModifiedFiles:     remainingFiles,
  1447→		MetadataDir:       metadataDir,
  1448→		MetadataDirAbs:    metadataDirAbs,
  1449→		CommitMessage:     "carry forward: uncommitted session files",
  1450→		IsFirstCheckpoint: false,
  1451→	})
  1452→	if err != nil {
  1453→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward failed",
  1454→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1455→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1456→		)
  1457→		return
  1458→	}
  1459→	if result.Skipped {
  1460→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward skipped (no changes)",
  1461→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1462→		)
  1463→		return
  1464→	}
  1465→
  1466→	// Update state for the carry-forward checkpoint.
  1467→	// CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0 is intentional: prompt-level carry-forward means
  1468→	// the next condensation re-processes the full transcript so the checkpoint is self-contained.
  1469→	state.FilesTouched = remainingFiles
  1470→	state.StepCount = 1
  1471→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0
  1472→	state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1473→
  1474→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-commit: carried forward remaining files",
  1475→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1476→		slog.Int("remaining_files", len(remainingFiles)),
  1477→	)
  1478→}

   124→// PromptAttribution captures line-level attribution data at the start of each prompt.
   125→// By recording what changed since the last checkpoint BEFORE the agent works,
   126→// we can accurately separate user edits from agent contributions.
   127→type PromptAttribution struct {
   128→	// CheckpointNumber is which checkpoint this was recorded before (1-indexed)
   129→	CheckpointNumber int `json:"checkpoint_number"`
   130→
   131→	// UserLinesAdded is lines added by user since the last checkpoint
   132→	UserLinesAdded int `json:"user_lines_added"`
   133→
   134→	// UserLinesRemoved is lines removed by user since the last checkpoint
   135→	UserLinesRemoved int `json:"user_lines_removed"`
   136→
   137→	// AgentLinesAdded is total agent lines added so far (base → last checkpoint).
   138→	// Always 0 for checkpoint 1 since there's no previous checkpoint to measure against.
   139→	AgentLinesAdded int `json:"agent_lines_added"`
   140→
   141→	// AgentLinesRemoved is total agent lines removed so far (base → last checkpoint).
   142→	// Always 0 for checkpoint 1 since there's no previous checkpoint to measure against.
   143→	AgentLinesRemoved int `json:"agent_lines_removed"`
   144→
   145→	// UserAddedPerFile tracks per-file user additions for accurate modification tracking.
   146→	// This enables distinguishing user self-modifications from agent modifications.

   151→// NormalizeAfterLoad applies backward-compatible migrations to state loaded from disk.
   152→// Call this after deserializing a State from JSON.
   153→func (s *State) NormalizeAfterLoad() {
   154→	// Migrate transcript fields: CheckpointTranscriptStart replaces both
   155→	// CondensedTranscriptLines and TranscriptLinesAtStart from older state files.
   156→	if s.CheckpointTranscriptStart == 0 {
   157→		if s.CondensedTranscriptLines > 0 {
   158→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.CondensedTranscriptLines
   159→		} else if s.TranscriptLinesAtStart > 0 {
   160→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.TranscriptLinesAtStart
   161→		}
   162→	}
   163→	// Clear deprecated fields so they aren't re-persisted.
   164→	// Note: this is a one-way migration. If the state is re-saved, older CLI versions
   165→	// will see 0 for these fields and fall back to scoping from the transcript start.
   166→	// This is acceptable since CLI upgrades are monotonic and the worst case is
   167→	// redundant transcript content in a condensation, not data loss.
   168→	s.CondensedTranscriptLines = 0
   169→	s.TranscriptLinesAtStart = 0
   170→
   171→	// Backfill AttributionBaseCommit for sessions created before this field existed.
   172→	// Without this, a mid-turn commit would migrate BaseCommit and the fallback in
   173→	// calculateSessionAttributions would use the migrated value, producing zero attribution.
   174→	if s.AttributionBaseCommit == "" && s.BaseCommit != "" {
   175→		s.AttributionBaseCommit = s.BaseCommit
   176→	}
   177→}
   178→
   179→// StateStore provides low-level operations for managing session state files.
   180→//
   181→// StateStore is a primitive for session state persistence. It is NOT the same as
   182→// the Sessions interface - it only handles state files in .git/entire-sessions/,
   183→// not the full session data which includes checkpoint content.
   184→//
   185→// Use StateStore directly in strategies for performance-critical state operations.
   186→// Use the Sessions interface (when implemented) for high-level session management.
   187→type StateStore struct {
   188→	// stateDir is the directory where session state files are stored
   189→	stateDir string
   190→}
   191→
   192→// NewStateStore creates a new state store.
   193→// Uses the git common dir to store session state (shared across worktrees).
   194→func NewStateStore() (*StateStore, error) {
   195→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir()
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   198→	}
   199→	return &StateStore{
   200→		stateDir: filepath.Join(commonDir, SessionStateDirName),

   203→
   204→// NewStateStoreWithDir creates a new state store with a custom directory.
   205→// This is useful for testing.
   206→func NewStateStoreWithDir(stateDir string) *StateStore {
   207→	return &StateStore{stateDir: stateDir}
   208→}
   209→
   210→// Load loads the session state for the given session ID.
   211→// Returns (nil, nil) when session file doesn't exist (not an error condition).
   212→func (s *StateStore) Load(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*State, error) {
   213→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   214→
   215→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   216→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   217→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   218→	}
   219→
   220→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   221→
   222→	data, err := os.ReadFile(stateFile) //nolint:gosec // stateFile is derived from sessionID
   223→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   224→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   225→	}
   226→	if err != nil {
   227→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   228→	}
   229→
   230→	var state State
   231→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   232→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   233→	}
   234→	state.NormalizeAfterLoad()
   235→	return &state, nil
   236→}
   237→
   238→// Save saves the session state atomically.
   239→func (s *StateStore) Save(ctx context.Context, state *State) error {
   240→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   241→
   242→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   243→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   244→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   245→	}
   246→
   247→	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.stateDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   248→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)
   249→	}
   250→
   251→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(state, "", "  ")
   252→	if err != nil {
   253→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   254→	}
   255→
   256→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)
   257→
   258→	// Atomic write: write to temp file, then rename
   259→	tmpFile := stateFile + ".tmp"
   260→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   261→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   262→	}
   263→	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, stateFile); err != nil {
   264→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to rename session state file: %w", err)
   265→	}
   266→	return nil
   267→}
   268→
   269→// Clear removes the session state file for the given session ID.
   270→func (s *StateStore) Clear(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   271→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   272→
   273→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   274→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   275→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   276→	}
   277→
   278→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   279→
   280→	if err := os.Remove(stateFile); err != nil {
   281→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   282→			return nil // Already gone, not an error
   283→		}
   284→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state file: %w", err)
   285→	}
   286→	return nil
   287→}
   288→
   289→// RemoveAll removes the entire session state directory.
   290→// This is used during uninstall to completely remove all session state.
   291→func (s *StateStore) RemoveAll() error {
   292→	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.stateDir); err != nil {
   293→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state directory: %w", err)
   294→	}
   295→	return nil
   296→}
   297→
   298→// List returns all session states.
   299→func (s *StateStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]*State, error) {
   300→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   301→
   302→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.stateDir)
   303→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   304→		return nil, nil
   305→	}
   306→	if err != nil {
   307→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state directory: %w", err)
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	var states []*State
   311→	for _, entry := range entries {
   312→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   313→			continue
   314→		}
   315→		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") {
   316→			continue // Skip temp files
   317→		}
   318→
   319→		sessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   320→		state, err := s.Load(ctx, sessionID)
   321→		if err != nil {
   322→			continue // Skip corrupted state files
   323→		}
   324→		if state == nil {
   325→			continue
   326→		}
   327→
   328→		states = append(states, state)
   329→	}
   330→	return states, nil
   331→}

   338→// getGitCommonDir returns the path to the shared git directory.
   339→// In a regular checkout, this is .git/
   340→// In a worktree, this is the main repo's .git/ (not .git/worktrees/<name>/)
   341→func getGitCommonDir() (string, error) {

    22→// TestPrepareCommitMsg_AmendPreservesExistingTrailer verifies that when amending
    23→// a commit that already has an Entire-Checkpoint trailer, the trailer is preserved
    24→// unchanged. source="commit" indicates an amend operation.
    25→func TestPrepareCommitMsg_AmendPreservesExistingTrailer(t *testing.T) {
    26→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
    27→	t.Chdir(dir)
    28→
    29→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
    30→
    31→	sessionID := "test-session-amend-preserve"
    32→	err := s.InitializeSession(sessionID, agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode, "", "")
    33→	require.NoError(t, err)
    34→
    35→	// Write a commit message file that already has the trailer
    36→	commitMsgFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "COMMIT_EDITMSG")
    37→	existingMsg := "Original commit message\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: abc123def456\n"
    38→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(existingMsg), 0o644))
    39→
    40→	// Call PrepareCommitMsg with source="commit" (amend)
    41→	err = s.PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile, "commit")
    42→	require.NoError(t, err)
    43→
    44→	// Read the file back and verify the trailer is still present
    45→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile)
    46→	require.NoError(t, err)
    47→
    48→	cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(string(content))
    49→	assert.True(t, found, "trailer should still be present after amend")
    50→	assert.Equal(t, "abc123def456", cpID.String(),
    51→		"trailer should preserve the original checkpoint ID")
    52→}

    54→// TestPrepareCommitMsg_AmendRestoresTrailerFromPendingCheckpointID verifies the amend
    55→// bug fix: when a user does `git commit --amend -m "new message"`, the Entire-Checkpoint
    56→// trailer is lost because the new message replaces the old one. PrepareCommitMsg restores
    57→// the trailer from PendingCheckpointID in session state.
    58→func TestPrepareCommitMsg_AmendRestoresTrailerFromPendingCheckpointID(t *testing.T) {

    61→
    62→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}

    74→	require.NoError(t, err)

    79→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(newMsg), 0o644))

    83→	require.NoError(t, err)

    87→	require.NoError(t, err)
    88→
    89→	cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(string(content))
    90→	assert.True(t, found,
    91→		"trailer should be restored from PendingCheckpointID on amend")
    92→	assert.Equal(t, "abc123def456", cpID.String(),

    98→// This is the case where the session has never been condensed yet.
    99→func TestPrepareCommitMsg_AmendNoTrailerNoPendingID(t *testing.T) {
   100→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   101→	t.Chdir(dir)
   102→
   103→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   104→
   105→	sessionID := "test-session-amend-no-id"

   113→	assert.Empty(t, state.PendingCheckpointID, "PendingCheckpointID should be empty by default")
   114→

   118→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(newMsg), 0o644))
   119→
   120→	// Call PrepareCommitMsg with source="commit" (amend)
   121→	err = s.PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile, "commit")
   122→	require.NoError(t, err)

   169→

   179→// StateStore provides low-level operations for managing session state files.

   182→// the Sessions interface - it only handles state files in .git/entire-sessions/,
   183→// not the full session data which includes checkpoint content.
   184→//
   185→// Use StateStore directly in strategies for performance-critical state operations.
   186→// Use the Sessions interface (when implemented) for high-level session management.
   187→type StateStore struct {

   189→	stateDir string
   190→}
   191→
   192→// NewStateStore creates a new state store.
   193→// Uses the git common dir to store session state (shared across worktrees).
   194→func NewStateStore() (*StateStore, error) {

   197→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)

   210→// Load loads the session state for the given session ID.

   213→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   214→
   215→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   216→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   217→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   218→	}

   220→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   221→
   222→	data, err := os.ReadFile(stateFile) //nolint:gosec // stateFile is derived from sessionID
   223→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   224→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   225→	}
   226→	if err != nil {
   227→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   228→	}

   230→	var state State
   231→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   232→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   233→	}
   234→	state.NormalizeAfterLoad()
   235→	return &state, nil
   236→}

   238→// Save saves the session state atomically.

   240→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use

   243→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   244→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   245→	}

   248→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)

   254→	}

   256→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)

   260→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   261→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   262→	}

   300→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use

   - The `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch should exist after condensation

- `TestPostCommit_FilesTouched_ResetsAfterCondensation`
- `TestTurnEnd_Active_NoActions`

   329→func TestTransition_rebase_GitCommit_is_noop_for_all_phases(t *testing.T) {
   330→	t.Parallel()
   331→
   332→	rebaseCtx := TransitionContext{IsRebaseInProgress: true}
   333→
   334→	for _, phase := range allPhases {
   335→		result := Transition(phase, EventGitCommit, rebaseCtx)
   336→		assert.Empty(t, result.Actions,
   337→			"rebase should produce empty actions for phase %s", phase)
   338→		assert.Equal(t, phase, result.NewPhase,
   339→			"rebase should not change phase for %s", phase)
   340→	}
   341→}

   343→func TestTransition_all_phase_event_combinations_are_defined(t *testing.T) {
   344→	t.Parallel()
   345→
   346→	// Verify that calling Transition for every (phase, event) combination
   347→	// does not panic and returns a valid phase.
   348→	for _, phase := range allPhases {
   349→		for _, event := range allEvents {
   350→			result := Transition(phase, event, TransitionContext{})
   351→			assert.NotEmpty(t, string(result.NewPhase),
   352→				"Transition(%s, %s) returned empty phase", phase, event)
   353→
   354→			// Verify the resulting phase is a known phase.
   355→			normalized := PhaseFromString(string(result.NewPhase))
   356→			assert.Equal(t, result.NewPhase, normalized,
   357→				"Transition(%s, %s) returned non-canonical phase %q",
   358→				phase, event, result.NewPhase)
   359→		}
   360→	}
   361→}

   363→func TestApplyCommonActions_SetsPhase(t *testing.T) {

   368→		NewPhase: PhaseActive,
   369→		Actions:  []Action{ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   370→	}
   371→
   372→	remaining := ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
   373→
   374→	assert.Equal(t, PhaseActive, state.Phase)
   375→	assert.Empty(t, remaining, "UpdateLastInteraction should be consumed")
   376→}

   378→func TestApplyCommonActions_UpdatesLastInteractionTime(t *testing.T) {

   384→	result := TransitionResult{

   392→	assert.False(t, state.LastInteractionTime.Before(before),
   393→		"LastInteractionTime should be >= test start time")
   394→}

   407→		Actions:  []Action{ActionClearEndedAt},

   410→	remaining := ApplyCommonActions(state, result)

   412→	assert.Nil(t, state.EndedAt, "EndedAt should be cleared")
   413→	assert.Equal(t, PhaseIdle, state.Phase)
   414→	assert.Empty(t, remaining, "ClearEndedAt should be consumed")
   415→}

   425→

   430→	assert.Equal(t, PhaseIdle, state.Phase)
   431→	require.NotNil(t, state.LastInteractionTime)
   432→}
   433→
   434→func TestApplyCommonActions_MultipleStrategyActions(t *testing.T) {

   449→func TestApplyCommonActions_WarnStaleSessionPassedThrough(t *testing.T) {

   478→func TestApplyCommonActions_EndedToActiveTransition(t *testing.T) {

   482→	state := &State{

   484→		EndedAt: &endedAt,
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Simulate ENDED → ACTIVE transition (EventTurnStart)
   488→	result := Transition(PhaseEnded, EventTurnStart, TransitionContext{})
   489→	remaining := ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
   490→
   491→	assert.Equal(t, PhaseActive, state.Phase)
   492→	assert.Nil(t, state.EndedAt, "EndedAt should be cleared on re-entry")
   493→	require.NotNil(t, state.LastInteractionTime)
   494→	assert.Empty(t, remaining, "all actions should be consumed")
   495→}
   496→
   497→func TestApplyCommonActions_EndedToIdleOnSessionStart(t *testing.T) {

   513→}

   515→func TestMermaidDiagram(t *testing.T) {

    16→// TestPrepareCommitMsg_AmendPreservesExistingTrailer verifies that when amending
    17→// a commit that already has an Entire-Checkpoint trailer, the trailer is preserved
    18→// unchanged. source="commit" indicates an amend operation.
    19→func TestPrepareCommitMsg_AmendPreservesExistingTrailer(t *testing.T) {
    20→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
    21→	t.Chdir(dir)
    22→
    23→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
    24→
    25→	sessionID := "test-session-amend-preserve"
    26→	err := s.InitializeSession(sessionID, agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode, "", "")
    27→	require.NoError(t, err)
    28→
    29→	// Write a commit message file that already has the trailer
    30→	commitMsgFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "COMMIT_EDITMSG")
    31→	existingMsg := "Original commit message\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: abc123def456\n"
    32→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(existingMsg), 0o644))
    33→
    34→	// Call PrepareCommitMsg with source="commit" (amend)
    35→	err = s.PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile, "commit")
    36→	require.NoError(t, err)
    37→
    38→	// Read the file back and verify the trailer is still present
    39→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile)
    40→	require.NoError(t, err)
    41→
    42→	cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(string(content))
    43→	assert.True(t, found, "trailer should still be present after amend")

    45→		"trailer should preserve the original checkpoint ID")

    53→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)

    24→// Bug: ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset returns absolute paths (e.g., /tmp/repo/src/main.go)
    25→// but getStagedFiles returns repo-relative paths (e.g., src/main.go). The exact-string
    26→// comparison in hasOverlappingFiles never matches, causing "no content to link".
    27→func TestSessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript_NormalizesAbsolutePaths(t *testing.T) {
    28→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
    29→	t.Chdir(dir)
    30→
    31→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
    32→	require.NoError(t, err)
    33→
    34→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
    35→
    36→	// Create a file that we'll stage
    37→	srcDir := filepath.Join(dir, "src")
    38→	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(srcDir, 0o755))
    39→	testFile := filepath.Join(srcDir, "main.go")
    40→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(testFile, []byte("package main\n"), 0o644))
    41→
    42→	wt, err := repo.Worktree()
    43→	require.NoError(t, err)
    44→	_, err = wt.Add("src/main.go")
    45→	require.NoError(t, err)
    46→
    47→	// Get the resolved worktree path first — on macOS, t.TempDir() returns /var/...
    48→	// but git resolves symlinks to /private/var/... . Claude Code uses the resolved
    49→	// path in its transcript, so we must too.
    50→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
    51→	require.NoError(t, err)
    52→	worktreeID, err := paths.GetWorktreeID(worktreePath)
    53→	require.NoError(t, err)
    54→
    55→	// Create a transcript file that references the file by absolute path
    56→	// (this is what Claude Code does — tool_use Write has absolute file_path)
    57→	absFilePath := filepath.Join(worktreePath, "src", "main.go")
    58→	transcriptContent := `{"type":"human","message":{"content":"write a main.go file"}}
    59→{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"` + absFilePath + `","content":"package main\n"}}]}}
    60→`
    61→	transcriptPath := filepath.Join(dir, "transcript.jsonl")
    62→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(transcriptPath, []byte(transcriptContent), 0o644))
    63→
    64→	// Create session state: no shadow branch (it was deleted after last condensation),
    65→	// transcript path points to the file, agent type is Claude Code
    66→	now := time.Now()
    67→
    68→	head, err := repo.Head()
    69→	require.NoError(t, err)
    70→
    71→	state := &SessionState{
    72→		SessionID:                 "test-abs-path-normalize",
    73→		BaseCommit:                head.Hash().String(),
    74→		WorktreePath:              worktreePath,
    75→		WorktreeID:                worktreeID,
    76→		StartedAt:                 now,
    77→		Phase:                     session.PhaseActive,
    78→		LastInteractionTime:       &now,
    79→		AgentType:                 agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode,
    80→		TranscriptPath:            transcriptPath,
    81→		CheckpointTranscriptStart: 0, // No prior condensation
    82→	}
    83→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))

    86→	// since there's no shadow branch
    87→	hasNew, err := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
    88→	require.NoError(t, err)

    90→		"sessionHasNewContent should return true when transcript has absolute paths "+
    91→			"that match repo-relative staged files after normalization")

    94→// TestPostCommit_NoTrailer_UpdatesBaseCommit verifies that when a commit has no
    95→// Entire-Checkpoint trailer, PostCommit still updates BaseCommit for active sessions.
    96→//
    97→// Bug: PostCommit early-returns when no trailer is found (line ~530-536). EventGitCommit
    98→// never fires, BaseCommit never updates. All subsequent commits fail the
    99→// BaseCommit == currentHeadHash filter in PrepareCommitMsg.
   100→func TestPostCommit_NoTrailer_UpdatesBaseCommit(t *testing.T) {
   101→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   102→	t.Chdir(dir)
   103→
   104→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   105→	require.NoError(t, err)
   106→
   107→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   108→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-no-trailer"
   109→
   110→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint
   111→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
   112→
   113→	// Set phase to ACTIVE
   114→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   115→	require.NoError(t, err)
   116→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
   117→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   118→
   119→	originalBaseCommit := state.BaseCommit
   120→
   121→	// Create a commit WITHOUT a trailer (user removed it, or mid-turn commit
   122→	// where PrepareCommitMsg couldn't add one due to Bug 1)
   123→	testFile := filepath.Join(dir, "test.txt")
   124→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(testFile, []byte("no trailer commit"), 0o644))
   125→	wt, err := repo.Worktree()
   126→	require.NoError(t, err)
   127→	_, err = wt.Add("test.txt")
   128→	require.NoError(t, err)
   129→	_, err = wt.Commit("commit without trailer", &git.CommitOptions{
   130→		Author: &object.Signature{
   131→			Name:  "Test",
   132→			Email: "test@test.com",
   133→			When:  time.Now(),
   134→		},
   135→	})
   136→	require.NoError(t, err)
   137→
   138→	// Get the new HEAD
   139→	head, err := repo.Head()
   140→	require.NoError(t, err)
   141→	newHeadHash := head.Hash().String()
   142→	require.NotEqual(t, originalBaseCommit, newHeadHash, "HEAD should have changed")
   143→
   144→	// Run PostCommit
   145→	err = s.PostCommit()
   146→	require.NoError(t, err)
   147→
   148→	// Verify BaseCommit was updated to new HEAD
   149→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   150→	require.NoError(t, err)
   151→	assert.Equal(t, newHeadHash, state.BaseCommit,
   152→		"BaseCommit should be updated to new HEAD even when commit has no trailer")
   153→
   154→	// Phase should stay ACTIVE (no state machine transition, just BaseCommit update)
   155→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActive, state.Phase,
   156→		"Phase should remain ACTIVE when commit has no trailer")
   157→}

   159→// TestSaveChanges_PreservesPendingCheckpointID verifies that SaveChanges does NOT
   160→// clear PendingCheckpointID. This field is set by PostCommit for deferred condensation
   161→// and should persist through SaveChanges calls until consumed by handleTurnEndCondense.
   162→//
   163→// Bug: SaveChanges clears PendingCheckpointID at line ~120. When the agent stops,
   164→// handleTurnEndCondense finds it empty, generates a new ID, and the commit trailer
   165→// and condensed data end up with different IDs.
   166→func TestSaveChanges_PreservesPendingCheckpointID(t *testing.T) {
   167→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)

   169→
   170→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   171→	require.NoError(t, err)

   173→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   174→	sessionID := "test-preserve-pending-cpid"
   175→
   176→	// Initialize session and save first checkpoint

   178→
   179→	// Set PendingCheckpointID (simulating what PostCommit does)
   180→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   181→	require.NoError(t, err)
   182→	const testPendingCpID = "abc123def456"
   183→	state.PendingCheckpointID = testPendingCpID
   184→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActiveCommitted
   185→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   186→
   187→	// Create metadata for a new checkpoint
   188→	metadataDir := ".entire/metadata/" + sessionID
   189→	metadataDirAbs := filepath.Join(dir, metadataDir)
   190→	// Transcript already exists from setupSessionWithCheckpoint
   191→
   192→	// Modify a file so the checkpoint has real changes
   193→	testFile := filepath.Join(dir, "src", "new_file.go")
   194→	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(testFile), 0o755))
   195→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(testFile, []byte("package src\n"), 0o644))
   196→
   197→	// Call SaveChanges — this should NOT clear PendingCheckpointID
   198→	err = s.SaveChanges(SaveContext{
   199→		SessionID:      sessionID,
   200→		ModifiedFiles:  []string{},
   201→		NewFiles:       []string{"src/new_file.go"},
   202→		DeletedFiles:   []string{},
   203→		MetadataDir:    metadataDir,
   204→		MetadataDirAbs: metadataDirAbs,
   205→		CommitMessage:  "Checkpoint 2",
   206→		AuthorName:     "Test",
   207→		AuthorEmail:    "test@test.com",
   208→	})
   209→	require.NoError(t, err)
   210→
   211→	// Reload state and verify PendingCheckpointID is preserved
   212→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   213→	require.NoError(t, err)
   214→	assert.Equal(t, testPendingCpID, state.PendingCheckpointID,
   215→		"PendingCheckpointID should be preserved across SaveChanges calls, "+
   216→			"not cleared — it's needed for deferred condensation at turn end")
   217→}

    14→func newResetCmd() *cobra.Command {
    15→	var forceFlag bool
    16→	var sessionFlag string

    18→	cmd := &cobra.Command{
    19→		Use:   "reset",
    20→		Short: "Reset the shadow branch and session state for current HEAD",
    21→		Long: `Reset deletes the shadow branch and session state for the current HEAD commit.
    22→
    23→This allows starting fresh without existing checkpoints on your current commit.
    24→
    25→Only works with the manual-commit strategy. For auto-commit strategy,
    26→use Git directly: git reset --hard <commit>
    27→
    28→The command will:
    29→  - Find all sessions where base_commit matches the current HEAD
    30→  - Delete each session state file (.git/entire-sessions/<session-id>.json)
    31→  - Delete the shadow branch (entire/<commit-hash>-<worktree-hash>)
    32→
    33→Use --session <id> to reset a single session instead of all sessions.
    34→
    35→Example: If HEAD is at commit abc1234567890, the command will:
    36→  1. Find all .json files in .git/entire-sessions/ with "base_commit": "abc1234567890"
    37→  2. Delete those session files (e.g., 2026-02-02-xyz123.json, 2026-02-02-abc456.json)
    38→  3. Delete the shadow branch entire/abc1234-fd5432
    39→
    40→Without --force, prompts for confirmation before deleting.`,
    41→		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
    42→			// Check if in git repository
    43→			if _, err := paths.RepoRoot(); err != nil {
    44→				return errors.New("not a git repository")
    45→			}
    46→
    47→			// Get current strategy
    48→			strat := GetStrategy()
    49→
    50→			// Check if strategy supports reset
    51→			resetter, ok := strat.(strategy.SessionResetter)
    52→			if !ok {
    53→				return fmt.Errorf("strategy %s does not support reset", strat.Name())
    54→			}
    55→
    56→			// Handle --session flag: reset a single session
    57→			if sessionFlag != "" {
    58→				return runResetSession(cmd, resetter, sessionFlag, forceFlag)
    59→			}
    60→
    61→			// Check for active sessions before bulk reset
    62→			if !forceFlag {
    63→				activeSessions, err := activeSessionsOnCurrentHead()
    64→				if err != nil {
    65→					fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Warning: could not check for active sessions: %v\n", err)
    66→					fmt.Fprintln(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Use --force to override.")
    67→					return nil
    68→				}
    69→				if len(activeSessions) > 0 {
    70→					fmt.Fprintln(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Active sessions detected on current HEAD:")
    71→					for _, s := range activeSessions {
    72→						fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "  %s (phase: %s)\n", s.SessionID, s.Phase)
    73→					}
    74→					fmt.Fprintln(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Use --force to override or wait for sessions to finish.")
    75→					return nil
    76→				}
    77→			}
    78→
    79→			if !forceFlag {
    80→				var confirmed bool
    81→
    82→				form := NewAccessibleForm(
    83→					huh.NewGroup(
    84→						huh.NewConfirm().
    85→							Title("Reset session data?").
    86→							Value(&confirmed),
    87→					),
    88→				)
    89→
    90→				if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
    91→					if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) {
    92→						return nil
    93→					}
    94→					return fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", err)
    95→				}
    96→
    97→				if !confirmed {
    98→					return nil
    99→				}
   100→			}

   102→			// Call strategy's Reset method

   105→			}
   106→
   107→			return nil
   108→		},
   109→	}

   111→	cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&forceFlag, "force", "f", false, "Skip confirmation prompt and override active session guard")
   112→	cmd.Flags().StringVar(&sessionFlag, "session", "", "Reset a specific session by ID")
   113→
   114→	return cmd
   115→}

   117→// runResetSession handles the --session flag: reset a single session.
   118→func runResetSession(cmd *cobra.Command, resetter strategy.SessionResetter, sessionID string, force bool) error {
   119→	// Verify the session exists
   120→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   121→	if err != nil {
   122→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session: %w", err)
   123→	}
   124→	if state == nil {
   125→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	if !force {
   129→		var confirmed bool
   130→
   131→		title := fmt.Sprintf("Reset session %s?", sessionID)
   132→		description := fmt.Sprintf("Phase: %s, Checkpoints: %d", state.Phase, state.StepCount)
   133→
   134→		form := NewAccessibleForm(
   135→			huh.NewGroup(
   136→				huh.NewConfirm().
   137→					Title(title).
   138→					Description(description).
   139→					Value(&confirmed),
   140→			),
   141→		)
   142→
   143→		if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   144→			if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) {
   145→				return nil
   146→			}
   147→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", err)
   148→		}
   149→
   150→		if !confirmed {
   151→			return nil
   152→		}
   153→	}
   154→
   155→	if err := resetter.ResetSession(sessionID); err != nil {
   156→		return fmt.Errorf("reset session failed: %w", err)
   157→	}
   158→
   159→	fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "Session %s has been reset. File changes remain in the working directory.\n", sessionID)
   160→	return nil
   161→}

   163→// activeSessionsOnCurrentHead returns sessions on the current HEAD
   164→// that are in an active phase (ACTIVE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED).
   165→func activeSessionsOnCurrentHead() ([]*session.State, error) {
   166→	repo, err := openRepository()
   167→	if err != nil {
   168→		return nil, err
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	head, err := repo.Head()
   172→	if err != nil {
   173→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   174→	}
   175→	currentHead := head.Hash().String()
   176→
   177→	states, err := strategy.ListSessionStates()
   178→	if err != nil {
   179→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   180→	}
   181→
   182→	var active []*session.State
   183→	for _, state := range states {
   184→		if state.BaseCommit != currentHead {
   185→			continue
   186→		}
   187→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   188→			active = append(active, state)
   189→		}
   190→	}
   191→
   192→	return active, nil
   193→}

   294→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	// Get the configured strategy
   298→	strat := GetStrategy()
   299→
   300→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place (auto-installs git hook, gitignore, etc. if needed)
   301→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   302→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   303→	}
   304→
   305→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   306→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   307→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   308→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   309→	}
   310→
   311→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at step/turn start)
   312→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   313→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   314→	if preState != nil {
   315→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   316→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   317→	}
   318→
   319→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   320→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   321→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   322→		// Subagents are stored in a subagents/ directory next to the main transcript
   323→		subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), sessionID, "subagents")
   324→		usage, err := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   325→		if err != nil {
   326→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", err)
   327→		} else {
   328→			tokenUsage = usage
   329→		}
   330→	}
   331→
   332→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   333→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   334→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   335→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   336→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   337→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   338→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   339→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   340→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   341→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   342→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   343→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   344→		AgentType:                agentType,
   345→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   346→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   347→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   348→	}
   349→
   350→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   351→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   352→	}
   353→
   354→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   355→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   356→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   357→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   358→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   359→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   360→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   361→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   362→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   363→		if loadErr != nil {
   364→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   365→		}
   366→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   367→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   368→		if sessionState == nil {
   369→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   370→				SessionID: sessionID,
   371→			}
   372→		}
   373→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   374→		sessionState.StepCount++
   375→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   376→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   377→		} else {
   378→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   379→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   380→		}
   381→	}
   382→
   383→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   384→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE.
   385→	// For ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE, HandleTurnEnd dispatches ActionCondense.
   386→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   387→
   388→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   389→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   390→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   391→	}
   392→
   393→	return nil
   394→}

   396→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   397→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   398→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   399→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   400→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   401→	if err != nil {
   402→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// Get agent for logging context
   406→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   407→	if err != nil {
   408→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   412→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   413→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   414→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   415→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   416→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   417→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   418→	)
   419→
   420→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   421→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   422→	if !found {
   423→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   424→		return nil
   425→	}
   426→
   427→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   428→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   429→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   430→		return nil
   431→	}
   432→
   433→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   434→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(nil)
   435→	if err != nil {
   436→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   437→		return nil
   438→	}
   439→
   440→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   441→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
   442→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   443→		return nil
   444→	}
   445→
   446→	// Get git author
   447→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   448→	if err != nil {
   449→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   450→		return nil
   451→	}
   452→
   453→	// Get the active strategy
   454→	strat := GetStrategy()
   455→
   456→	// Ensure strategy setup is complete
   457→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   458→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   459→		return nil
   460→	}
   461→
   462→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   463→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   464→	if sessionID == "" {
   465→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   466→	}
   467→
   468→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   469→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   470→
   471→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   472→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   473→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   474→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   475→	if todoContent == "" {
   476→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   477→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   478→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   479→		if todoCount > 0 {
   480→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   481→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   482→		}
   483→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   484→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   488→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   489→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   490→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   491→	}
   492→
   493→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   494→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   495→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   496→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   497→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   498→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   499→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   500→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   501→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   502→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   503→		IsIncremental:       true,
   504→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   505→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   506→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   507→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   508→		AgentType:           agentType,
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   512→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   513→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   514→		return nil
   515→	}
   516→
   517→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   518→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   519→	return nil
   520→}
